Best part was Josh Capon came out and chatted with us about the menu. Brought us some duck lasagna and oysters. Even better than the burger. And the grand finale was the ridiculous skillet cookie with ice cream and caramel. Go here. Now. 

Great food, great service, great place. Start saving now.

Great atmosphere and food!! The steak was cooked perfectly. The female bartender was on point with the drinks. Sorry I can't remember her name. My friends lobster looked so good even though I didn't taste it. He devoured it!!

Definitely a place to splurge. A NY steakhouse with NY prices, everything we got was delicious - and the service was great too. Started with some delicious cocktails, a Manhattan and a rum drink from their menu; both excellent. Got the meatball appetizer which was to die for with perfect seasoning and sauce, served creatively over polenta. The bone in filet was tasty with a nice char, served with roasted garlic on top that you could add to your taste. The chicken dish is also delicious, half a bird served over roast veggies in a tasty sauce. Really like the atmosphere and vibe inside, which was nice but not pretentious or over the top like many NY steakhouses.

Service is good but it falls off from there. The 100 day dry aged steak is just average for an incredibly overpriced $163. I asked if i should order this or the 40 day dry aged rib eye and was recommended this. If you're coming here for steak, don't. I'd be hard pressed to ever return.

Atmosphere is like most non-NYC steakhouses, dimly lit, nothing to really speak of. No need to overpay for an average steakhouse experience in NYC. Plenty of better options in the city.

Great service. 
No wait for two on Saturday night around 6:15pm. 
Food came out very quick. We ordered:
-Devils egg- excellent 
(If you get here before 7, ask if you can order from "happy hours by the bar" price is cheaper by at least half)
-Lobster Mac and cheese was great but a bit too salty 
-Bowery steak -excellent and delicious whipped potato, didn't care for the salsa.
-Snake river Denver steak -texture was superb, too salty again.
 Both steaks came out medium rare to rare in the middle. We ordered medium. Great texture and quality anyways so we didn't complain.

Overall 4 stars because everything was just a bit too salty in my opinion, drank lots of water. To be extra picky, kind of disappointed that the butter for bread was cold and hard. Made it very difficult to apply.

Wow again! Bowery Meat Company never fails to deliver. I have been going since it opened and I feel like it just keeps getting better. Chef and owner Josh Capon is simply one of the best hosts and chefs in town. He works the room and treats the customers as family coming to his house for a spectacular feast. And speaking of feast -- we went for the broiler oysters, salmon tartare, and duck wings to start. Each were perfect and a few extra items showed up as well. The duck lasagna has been on the menu from the beginning and there is a reason -- duck lasagna rocks. This time for steaks we had a grass fed bone in sirloin which completely delivered and the Bowery Steak which is the ribeye cap and just fabulous. Add a lobster and the fantastic sides of mushrooms, spinach and potatoes and boy oh boy what a meal. Desert simply shifts it into overdrive -- chocolate chip cookie pie and an ice cream sundae. Drop the mike. Can't wait for my next visit!

I was invited on this company dinner outing to BMC. I was impressed. The place is beautiful and busy. I hear the reservations are hard to come by but let's just say our company was let in to dine. A bit pricey but the food and drinks make up for it. Real fresh eggs & eggs from the Raw bar (oysters) was the kick off to an amazing meal. Their steaks are well aged and delicious. All in all a great time had by all.

Great meat selection and if you don't know much about meat, they will help you deepen your understanding. Meat was perfectly cook. Wine pairing is recommended if you have the opportunity. However, we will give the super star dish to the keylime cheese cake with gingerbread crust, best ever, phenomenal!! 

At Bowery Meat Company, NY. We had Farmer Salad and Tomahawk Ribeye (45days aged) for our main course. The juicy medium rare ribeye was fabulously delicious, paired with pinot noir from Oregon, Alchemist 2014 (full body, but light). Our dessert was a Key Lime cheese cake, topped with soft meringue on flame. This cheese cake was phenomenal. It was very delicate, and complex in flavor n texture.

Amazing meal from start to finish. Josh Capon is the consummate host, accessible to all as he frequents each table. Recommend the ribeye for 2 and their ridiculous steak sauce. Amazing atmosphere with an eclectic mix of music to keep it lively and fun. Huge inviting  bar and a tremendous staff all willing to accommodate your every need.

All my life I wanted to try a steak by Josh Capon and his team and for my birthday I finally went. And til this day I crave that beautifully cooked and amazing tasting Côte de Boeuf. We got it Medium because my gf can't deal with medium-rare like myself (she's slowly getting there), either way, best steak I ever had. Ate it with a side of fries. We also had complimentary duck lasagna, which was really really good. 

If I can eat here all the time I would. Gotta come with deep pockets  worth every penny though. 11/10

The atmosphere is incredible here (very modern/trendy). We were seated at a great booth. For appetizers we got the duck wings and the duck lasagna. Both dishes were great. For the main course we got the porter house and the double ribeye. The double ribeye was one of the best steaks I have had in nyc. The quality compares to Keen's and Peter Luger (bit higher price). Along with the steaks we got three sauces and four sides. For the sides we got potatoes, Brussels sprouts, lobster Mac and cheese, and and the creamed spinach. The creamed spinach was the best of the bunch and the lobster Mac and cheese was the only thing that wasn't good the whole night. Overall, this was a delicious meal that was a little pricey.

To start:

ricotta
broiled oysters
wedge salad
farmer salad
bacon

Everything was outstanding, particularly the broiled oysters and the farmer salad. The salad had watermelon radishes and was dressed perfectly. The bacon was too fatty, but that's just me. Everyone else at my table enjoyed it. 

For dinner:

cap ribeye
ribeye
filet

The cap ribeye was voted most popular, and was the perfect size and well marbled. My personal favorite was the filet, cooked and served with garlic and delightfully juicy. 

For dessert:

cheesecake
cast iron cookie
s'mores sunday

Honestly, they were all great but it was truly too much food. Our server also brought a small bowl of salted carmel dark chocolate ice cream bites, and if I knew that was coming I wouldn't have gotten a proper dessert. Our server was A+, very knowledgeable and attentive, funny and friendly. I would highly recommend.

My boyfriend violently pooped three times within an hour of leaving this restaurant. Hence the rating. Now let's talk about the food:

The starters and desserts were definitely the stars of the show. The complementary bread was buttery, sweet, and succulent like large chunks of sea salt on top to add a rustic feel. The broiled oysters were extremely flavorful (though a bit salty). Before you order, the waitress brings out all of the steaks they have available and tell you about them and how they prepare them. The steaks themselves were not as good as other steakhouses in the city (especially when you're paying $200), but definitely better than anything I could have made at home. Their ice cream was smooth and creamy; quite the lovely finish to the meal.

Duck Lasagna! Steaks! Lamb Chops! 
A great spot with good vibe.
Chef came out to our table, a nice touch.

My boyfriend and I made a reservation at Bowery Meat Company to celebrate our anniversary. We started with a bottle of red, and got the broiled oysters and crispy duck wings as our apps. The service here takes a while -- it took a long time for our waiter to bring over the giant meat board (this is how they try to upsell you on the more expensive cuts of meat) and take our order. But once we got our appetizers, absolutely no complaints. Both dishes were delicious, as was the free bread and butter (the rolls were served hot) and the mini arancini balls they give you at the beginning of the meal! 

We both ordered the bone-in ribeye, and here had somewhat different experiences. I ordered my steak medium rare, and it definitely came out much closer to medium. My steak also had giant chunks of fat all around the meat (probably around 1/4 was pure fat) -- my boyfriend's steak was much leaner, and actually came out rare, like he ordered. That said, the meat was well seasoned, pretty tender, and tasted good. And the shishito peppers that came on the side were great as well! I've definitely had much better steak for about half the price, though. 

My favorite part of the meal was honestly the sour cream and onion hashbrown, which our waiter convinced us to order as a side. You need this!! It came out hot, crispy, and perfect. 

In terms of ambiance, this restaurant definitely has the look of the new, modern, steakhouse trying to pretend it's not a steakhouse. The music here was just bizarre -- they were playing pop hits from the late 2000s (not an exaggeration: "I Kissed A Girl" and "Poker Face" were blasting as we waited for our food). Definitely good people-watching to be found here, as there was an interesting mix of huge tables of finance bros, very Italian couples (to clarify: Jersey Shore Italian), and families sitting around us. 

Overall, the food was good (especially all the sides and appetizers), but way, way overpriced for what it is.

My friend took me to Bowery Meat Company for my birthday dinner.   The place is really nice, waiter is friendly and the drinks is good.   For appetizer we order Broiled Oysters.  It was so good..  The burn flavor is really good.  Entree, we order Tomahawk Ribeye 40oz with the side of Sauteed Mushrooms & Sour Cream & Onion Hash Brown  The Steak is cook to perfection.  It was really tender.  As for the sides, both is really delicious.  For desserts, we order Cookies N' Cream Ice Cream Cake & Banana cream pie.  Both is really good.  We both left the place very happy and full.  I would definitely come back again.

This place had amazing atmosphere and amazing service. What I loved most about this place is when they bring over the board of different meat cuts and explain every single one to you. 

We started with the duck lasagna and the steak tartar. The lasagna was good but it is rich. Maybe a bit too rich for my liking but it's good nonetheless. The steak tarar- well I found the bread that was provided with it overly burnt that when I ate it, all I could taste was burned bread. 

Now onto the steak. I got the strip wagyu and my wife got the ribcap wagyu. The rib cap is definitely the way to go. Delicious and flavorful. My strip was disappointing. I could taste a lot of char on the steak and I got more of a medium than a medium rare like I Asked.

The broccolini was delicious and so were the shishito peppers. The potato hasbrown was salty and apparently so was the  creamed spinach that I did not try.

The best part of the meal was that delicious bread pudding! By far one of the best bread puddings I've ever had!

Went here with a couple friends for dinner on a Thursday night. We had a reservation and were able to be seated right away.

First thing that stands out about this place is that it is quite loud--there are lots of large tables here and it seems to draw a business-type crowd.

After perusing the menu, we decided to split a few dishes:

BMC meatballs (4 stars): These were good--nothing groundbreaking, but a solid dish nonetheless, and I really enjoyed the sauce.

Duck lasagna (4.5 stars): This is their bread and butter dish and it was no disappointment. I don't know who decided to put duck in a lasagna, but it really works for this dish.

Bone-in filet mignon with garlic confit (4.5 stars): The meat was cooked perfectly and was absolutely phenomenal when paired with the roasted garlic.

Sour cream and onion hash brown (3.5 stars): This was an interesting dish, but nothing that really 'wow'ed us.

Sauteed spinach (3.5 stars): Again, a classic dish that was decent, but nothing to write home about.

Cast-iron chocolate chip cookie (4 stars): This was a fun dessert and super rich--definitely worth splitting with your party at the end of your meal if you have any room.

Overall, this place served up some great food and had a lively atmosphere. The prices are bit high, but the quality of food is there to match. Not a bad spot if you're looking for a nice steakhouse on the east side.

This place is 10/10, Food was absolutely delicious, we had the 100 day aged rib eye for 2 with whipped mash and asparagus, it was amazing. Then for dessert we got the chocolate chip ice cream cake it was out of this world, the service was excellent and the drinks were also very good, the only bad point I will give it was the prices, you have to come here with money to spend but I guess you pay for what you get.

Great steak and great service! The staff knew exactly what to recommend and will even bring out the cuts of meat to describe each to you. 
Food was delicious, highly recommend the duck lasagna, duck wings and any of the steak cuts. Even the sides were amazing (get the lobster mac!)

Honestly this place was amazing for my birthday dinner. We started off with the steak tartar, ricotta and crab special- all were fantastic. Lindsey the server was really attentive but also great about giving our two top the time and space to enjoy our meal- at our own pace. When our entrees came out, we ordered the filet, the grass fed 18oz steak, Bernaise sauce, Romesco sauce, whipped potatoes and broccolini. We also ordered the lobster Mac n cheese, but felt that it was too salty for our liking, sadly we sent it back. As soon as that issue came up, the manager stepped over and and was more than accommodating, attempting to resolve a problem, when we were so happy- that there was no problem. Steaks were phenomenal, cooked to temp, potatoes were well seasoned, and sautéed broccolini not overly sautéed. 

Lindsey presented us with a birthday dessert, and Jeremy helped me choose an alternative bottle of champagne as the one I picked only came in half bottles. Jeremy the somm was great, very knowledgeable and personable. Service was outstanding the whole night, Paulo, took over for Lindsey to finish the night out and we were also beyond happy with him. 

Only bad part, please update the available wine list online as it is not accurate to what is available. 

Ask for Lindsey, or Paulo for your dinner here- and you will never be disappointed.

This is a good rendition of a modern steakhouse. Too bad the center piece of the experience did not deliver as I expected. I ordered the $168 100-day dry aged 32oz ribeye, expecting to be hit with strong flavors... But it didn't taste much different from an average 28 day aged steak. I was really looking forward to it, but it was quite disappointing, given its price and its age. Everything else was wonderful, ranging from the Ricotta appetizer to the potato and spinach sides. But the only thing I would probably want to order again is the Ricotta appetizer, not the steak...

Let me start with the food was great andvery delicious. The oysters were supreme. Fresh and flavorful. The filet mignon was cooked to perfection and was tasty. The sommelier was really helpful and so kind. Our waitress on the other hand was rude, pretentious, and had an overall bad attitude. This is an expensive place so when the service is trash it's really disappointing. She was rushing us out of there the whole time and was very demeaning in the way she answered some of our questions. I'm sure most of the wait staff is not as condescending as our particular waitress but it really affected our night out. Overall I'm giving four stars bc the food was really great and the sommelier was so so delightful but our bad attitude waitress really brought the rating down.

Came to Bowery Meat Company with some friends last night after having heard great reviews from co-workers and additional research on yelp. The hostess who sat us was very nice and even brought us a complimentary Whipped Ricotta appetizers (delicious). We all ended up getting different items to really get a good idea of what Bowery Meat Company has to offer.

Myself and two others split two appetizers: the Crispy duck wings and the Hand Cut steak tartare. Both appetizers were absolutely amazing. The duck wings were super crispy and had a tasty dark glaze on top. THe steak tartare was perfectly salty and paired well with the crisp lettuce + toasted bread. 

For my steak, I split the Porterhouse for two. The steak was very tasty and perfectly medium rare. Very good steak. Others got the Chateubriand, 100 day dry aged Ribeye, and the bone in Ribeye. I was able to get a slice of the Chateubriand and the bone in ribeye. The Chateubriand was the best cut of meat! As for the Bone-in Ribeye, it was pretty tough. The two individuals who ordered the Bone-in Ribeye agreed that it was tough. 

It is worth noting that 2 guests in our party ordered a 100 day dry aged Ribeye and it turned out that they forgot about it so we waited a while for them to get their steak.

For dessert we ordered the Strawberry Rhubarb Crumble special. This was awesome and very sweet. A nice way to end the meal. The chef also gave us complimentary bread pudding which was also very tasty. 

One good thing about this place is that they give out a lot of complimentary items. The con is that this place is quite expensive. This is the most I've spent at a Steakhouse to date.

Ambiance: more bistro then steakhouse, almost club-like music.
Service: excellent
Food: honestly, quite average, a very skinny bone in ribeye that showed up on the small side. Good flavor.
Price: ridiculously high for the product.

Food here is superb, but concierge/ front desk team is extremely rude. 

They didn't have our reservation, despite me calling and confirming 2 hours prior and I heard them commenting on my partners wardrobe multiple times. The table to our left had a young man with a baseball cap on and everyone around us had jeans on. Beyond rude to be commenting on attire for your customers to hear. 

For the amazing food and nice ambiance, the management team really needs to step up their customer service and clienteling. For a customer who's has been to this restaurant 10+ times, I'm now extremely frustrated and will no longer recommend this restaurant.

Beware of overcooked steaks! Beware of management is trying to persuade you that it is NOT (they know better if it is not overcooked)

I understand that sometimes steaks get overcooked) Even though I specifically mentioned to waiter : please it is better to undercook than overcooked.

My waiter brought an overcooked steak. We cut it together - I asked for medium rare, it was clearly medium. We agreed that it was overcooked. So he said sorry and the kitchen will replace it .

But then the Manager brought it back on the plate saying that "take a look on other side it is not overcooked and You can enjoy it". When I showed him cut in middle of over cooked steak he replied the steak could not be cooked evenly to my preference.

I decided to return my steak that was definitely overcooked and still payed a 200$ bill for sides, wine and one steak. So the dinner was ruined as only one of us could eat the steak)

Very SAD
PS they took away overcooked steak but never took away the sauce) Enjoy if you have to but I'll skip)

Yes food was good but they told us we had to leave because we were sitting for too long...Rude! So all I can remember about my experience was them telling us to leave and nobody was waiting for a table because we left a little bit after 10 and it closes at 11.

Best steak in New York city and chef Capon is the most experienced at creating the best presentation with high quality proteins. Absolutely amazing. I am a tenured chef and I understand the importance of seasoning and he gets it perfect. Highly recommend.

This may have been one of the best experiences I've had at a steakhouse. Everything was top-notch and enjoyable without being too over the top or too rustic - it made for a very comfortable evening. 

FOOD: 5/5
 Everything was delicious, but two dishes were out of this world. The hand-cut steak tartare along with the bread and lettuce is flavorful and fresh. One of the best I've had. 
The main dish of the night- the tomahawk ribeye was perfectly cooked; red on the inside and charred on the outside. The texture was fantastic, again one of the best I've had. 

DESSERT: 5/5
 Don't skip dessert!!! Per our server's suggestion, we got the cast iron chocolate chip cookie (reluctantly, because I don't eat chocolate) but boy was this mouthwateringly good. Perfect way to end the fantastic dinner

AMBIANCE: 4.5/5
Comfortable setting, excellent decor. It completes the experience. 

SERVICE: 10/5
I had not expected to have such fantastic service. Our server, friendly yet knowledgeable, approachable yet not pushy, recommended some fantastic dishes that I will definitely not forget. Not to mention him serving us a portion of the duck lasagna after contemplating it for a long time (we didn't order it because we thought it would be too much food). 

All in all amazing experience and amazing food!!!

Disappointed in the steaks - grass fed NY strip was tough and sinewy. Rib eye Bowery was flavorful but the herb topping was distracting, wish that had been on the side. Side dishes were all yummy - try the duck lasagna!, but 3 stars for the overpriced steaks, since that is what we came for. Excellent and friendly attentive service.
Ordered from seamless several desserts. They canceled after 90 minutes with no apology. Will not reorder.

I loved my experience while dining here.

The food is amazing and the owner/chef was personable.

He came out, educated us and ensured we had a great dining experience.

My wife and I are fanatical Chopped fans and about a month ago there was a meat-centric episode ("Belly of the Beast") and Lucas Billheimer competed. When I saw what restaurant he was from I said "We're going there!". So, we went and it was just fantastic. This steakhouse is just over the top. The meats, of course, are excellent. The wine list and bar holdings are exceptional as well. I don't have details, just the memory of a perfect culinary evening. If you are keto or a neolithic caveman, you will love this restaurant. My wife and daughter are gluten-free and they were accommodated. I plan to return on my next trip to NYC.

Hosted work Dinner here. The front of house manager was phenomenal. Our waitress was amazing. We had a preset menu that was family style. It was impressive and delicious. We started with house made ricotta and bread. 
The ricotta was fresh and had amazing seasoning. Then we moved onto broiled oysters, meat balls and kung pao duck wings. The broiled oysters with lemon was phenomenal. The meatballs with polenta were delicious. The duck wings were really tender and tasty! Next course was duck lasagna and mixed green salad. The duck lasagna was delicious and the salad was refreshing. The main course was a presliced tomahawk steak and broiled lobster. OH MY LORD. Life altering. If that wasn't enough the bread pudding for dessert was just .. amazing. I can't wait to go back !

Excellent service , great presentation, the price points are aggressive, but you can't bring it with you when you're dead.. right?  (but seriously I'm still recovering from that dinner 6 weeks ago- and I do ok)- chef is the man and he was came over and introduced himself and recommended dishes which you can't put a price on, great layout- very nice atmosphere- a great Manhatten establishment as a steak house aficionado
I can't even remember everything we ordered because we ate like crazy assholes, but get the Bowery steak!
My friends and I had soluch a great time eating here that we shut the place down! Great tasting food, good music and beautiful ambiance!
The food is spectacular and so is the service. I'll be back next time in NYC. They had a cool music playlist. Cool steak place not stuffy and old school.

One of my favorite places to get a steak in the city, relatively easy to get a reservation. Love how the waiter will come out with all the cuts of meat to show you your selection. The shishito peppers on my steak were delicious and added a little crunch to the meal. Dim lighting, light music, a lot more modern interior than some of the more "old school" steakhouses in the city. Good for romantic date night or dinner with the fam.

Good service but the steaks are burnt or swimming in oil. The appetizer I took was roasted carrots which had mint and fried rice which felt like I might break a tooth if I eat it. The only good dish was the spinach side dish. This place was recommended so maybe its just the wrong day to eat there.

The best steak house. I have been here so many times and have never had an issue or been let down. They almost always give a complimentary dish. The steak is always super flavorful and cooked to perfection. The Oreo cake here is my favorite. It is not overly chocolately and not too heavy.

Came here for a special occasion and I have to say the service was top notch and friendly. Restaurant is pricey but you should know that going in. There were some small bites they provided along the way and they even gave us some extra sides to round out the meal. 
However the food was a letdown. Everything was extremely salty. Literally every dish was over-salted.  Upon informing the staff they were very apologetic and provided some amazing deserts on the house. 
If you want the best steak in NYC just head to Wolfgang's on Park.

Second time coming here! The steaks were AMAZING. All 3 of the ones we ordered were all tender and melts in my mouth. We got the tomahawk steak, wagyu and the filet mignon. Surprisingly although the tomahawk one was probably the most expensive one out of the three, I liked the filet mignon and wagyu one better. I also ordered their red wine and it goes pretty well with the steak! Service was also too notch here. Would definitely be back
Great food and excellent service. Overall, it was a good dining experience. I would come back again!

For being a premium high quality steak restaurant we had a very disappointing experience. We ordered one of the top dollar dry aged steaks and when we received it it was very tough and dry. Absolutely, not what a dry aged steak should be. When we gave our honest opinion the management then tried to "school us" on dry aging to try to correct the situation but there's no correcting when a piece of meat that should be tender and juicy comes out tough and dry. After a 5 minute debate the food was sent back and the chef agreed that we got a bad piece of steak. Now, normally I'd never write this review but honestly it was just a bad experience and if I can save anyone $500.00 then I rather write this up so they can correct whatever management issues they are having. Also, we felt very disrespected that the management tried to fix the situation by sending out a fleet of desserts instead of listening to us when we said we were already full. Overall, a bad experience and disappointed we are heading to Virginia as such.

I like the way they show the beef - a really good collection of prime and Wagyu cuts displayed in all it's glory.

Complimentary Duck Lasagna was set out, and some appetizers, Lamb meatballs and Kung Pao Duck Wings both absolutely flavorful and really sets the tone for overindulgence. Freshly baked bread and rich butter were top quality, and so are the sides of green beans and lobster ravioli - pretty large chunks in there.

But the real star was the Snake River Farms Wagyu double-cut NY Strip, which 3 of us shared ($220). It was totally worth it - best quality beef one can taste, and you don't need to eat a pound of it as it's so rich and umami-satisfying. Totally worth it. Best steak I've had in all of NY (and there were some good ones). It was serves with some baked garlic and shishito peppers, whooohoo!

Beautiful place and cool location, service was professional, efficient and friendly without being overbearing.

My only gripe is that why can't these upscale steakhouses offer reasonably priced wine? Everything decent is over $100. For that, one star off.

After coming back a few times, I can confidently say that the salmon is not worth the price. I was disappointed with the quality and thought it was not worth close to $40 for salmon atop over-salted veggies. Get the burger - you won't regret it!
Exceptional dining experience. Food was excellent, service was outstanding.  Definitely would recommend. Not to mention, Andres is the best.
Service was on point. But the food itself was so so. Nothing spectacular about the steak (porterhouse for 2) or sides. Bacon was super salty.

Was a little nervous because I typically don't care for bone-in steaks but the filet was cooked perfectly and easy to separate from the bone. Drinkswise, did the Malbec while he did a hibiki old fashioned. Started with the gem salad, they also gave us these little pesto cheese balls on the house, both were nice. He also did the filet, we split twice baked potato (I loved!) and they gave us free green beans... nice touch but I don't really care for them so they weren't really eaten. Also added bernaise sauce and the house sauce, both equally great compliments to the steaks. Finished with the cookie ice cream dessert which they put a little candle and chocolate in. Also very delicious though knocking star because it was a birthday celebration and I feel like it should've been free & they sat us next to people when there was ample seating the next table over and would've given us more space. Overall, would recommend if you want a nice dinner out! Love the meat tray that they show you all the cuts and options. Good option for large groups or small groups with large appetites lmao.

Ooookay I just gotta say this first...they have the best old fashions here! I ordered a Basil Hayden old fashion and it's one of the best I've ever had. 
Whoever was behind the bar on 8/27 you the sh*t! Keep up the good work.

You know who was also the sh*t?? The General Manager Devone. He made sure we felt welcomed since the moment he saw me posing for IG pictures out in front of the restaurant. We were celebrating my boyfriends birthday and the entire experience there was incredible. They made us feel special and like our business was very much appreciated without being overbearing.

Now the food.. wow just wow. The warm dinner buns and butter melt in your mouth. The complimentary duck lasagna small bite plate they gave us was delicious. Grateful they did that because that wouldn't be a dish I would normally order and I would have missed out! The 20oz ribeye was cooked perfectly and I paired it with a twice bake potato. My bf got the NY steak and that also did not disappoint. They also gave us a side of the creamed spinach oh man that was great too!  

To finish off the dinner they sent over some bite sized dessert pieces & dessert wine. Truly a wonderful experience we will be back!

Not sure why this place is so highly rated.

The duck lasagna was amazing, and definately worth splitting while waiting for the steaks.

We split the Tomahawk Ribeye 40oz with the lobster mac and cheese. They brought us pureed potatoes on the side as a complimentary side as well as a small complimentary starter and desert which was much appreciated. 

The Tomahawk Ribeye was ordered medium-rare, but burnt to a nasty taste on the outside. Despite that it was medium rare on the inside the burnt crust couldn't be disguised. I've had steaks at half the price that tasted twice as good at other restaurants. That being said, the lobster mac and cheese was delicious and I would highly recommend it.

We were asked twice if we were done with our plates even though we were still clearly eating and took it as a cue to ask for the check. They even started setting our table for another party while we were finishing our drinks. We had only been there for an hour and a half so it's not like we were taking up the table for an unreasonable amount of time. Also there were other open tables. Our waitress then double backed to let us know that they weren't in a big rush to cash us out, and would we like dessert? 


Uhhhh..no thanks. Left for the next place. Will not be returning. Can get way better steaks at half the price at other places. The staff pressure you to leave for no apparent reason. Would not recommend.

So glad we decided to come here tonight over The Strip House! Food was incredible and service was even better. We had the grass fed strip and the 20oz rib eye as well as the duck wings and hash browns! The staff was incredibly friendly and helpful. We loved the drinks and definitely save room for the key lime pie. Only complaint was the tables for two were a little close together!

This is my new favorite steak house, top level service and food. Loved the ambiance and experience. Our waiter manny was one of a kind and definitely made our experience that much better. Would definitely go back and highly recommend to anyone who loves steaks and great drinks.

This place is amazing, and is right up there with Peter Lugers!!  The steaks are exceptional, the drinks are amazing, and the duck lasagna is a wonderful surprise!  The icing on the cake is the exceptional service, and the special "tasting" items that kept coming out.  This is the ideal place for a special dinner or celebration.

Bread was great, duck wings were incredible, and side dishes were  very good. Drinks were WAY overpriced and steaks were super dry!!! I've been to dozens of steakhouses that were similar in price and this was by far the worst one. My steak was super charred...so much that it took all the flavor out and was very dry. I had to order a "sauce" to help with the dryness in which they charged me $7 for. Save your money and time and go somewhere different.

Bowery Meat Company is the steakhouse created by chef owner Josh Capon. Chef Capon the chef owner of Lure, the classic Soho seafood restaurant, and a number of other area restaurants. With Bowery Meat Company, Capon shows that his magic is just great with meat as it is with seafood. From the cocktails and wine to the apps to the steaks to the desserts, a meal at Bowery Meat Company is an enjoyable and delicious experience. I don't eat beef that often, but when I do I want it to be at Bowery Meat Company.

I was very underwhelmed with Bowery Meat Company, specifically the steaks. Our steaks were medium rare (what we wanted), however they were way too chargrilled. The duck lasagna and ricotta cheese were good. If you want to eat steak, then I suggest trying Striphouse in Union Square or Keen's in Midtown. I wouldn't return to Bowery Meat Company, not a New Yorker restaurant.

Went to Bowery meat last night and the food was amazing! Food cooked to perfection everything was good but a few things that turned me off. 

1-We ordered a nice bottle of wine-multiple apps- a steak that was on special (over 200$) and sides we never got offered bread or anything "from the chef"  the table next to us was drinking water wearing basketball shorts and salads and had multiple things offered to try duck lasagna-bread- rice balls(not a big deal but treat everyone the same especially if we are sitting on top of each other)

2- Ordered water and finished it at the end of the meal we were not asked if we wanted another just assumed to open another  and maybe had a sip of the second bottle 

3- Put into our reservations that we were celebrating a 30th birthday nothing was acknowledged- it was a Monday once again who cares but why ask in the reservation? 

4- Just went to get my left overs and 2 sides we ordered were never given to us- not a big deal just really want some mashed potatoes they were amazing! 

5-We had things wrapped and rather than waiting till the end of the meal it was given to me to hold on a bench- the seats are very close together so maybe hold on to these until the meal is over it was like having a large bag next to you the ENTIRE TIME 

Would I return? Yes - could some little things improve always!
Was here with my sister and mom for a birthday dinner and had a great time.  Staff was very friendly and helpful.  Food was delicious.

This place was very underwhelming.  (They were packed...so maybe other people think different?). The steak was awful.  It was burned on the outside and it needed the special order sauce for any shred of flavor.  The potatoes tasted like oatmeal.  The bread and salad were pretty good.  But the salad had bacon in it - and bacon makes everything taste good.  This is def a NY mediocre restaurant at best.  Not worth the money.

So we started cocktails and beer by the bar. Also went and tried one of their happy hour local raw oysters. Then moved onto the table. Tonight I came here and it was just the two people. Ordered clam claws from the raw bar and the roasted cauliflower. The appetizer was very good. For main course we ordered the tomahawk steak for 2 with French fries and Brussels sprouts on the side. The steak came out to the right temperature, flavor was on point and no complain. Price is right for the area. Service was really good. A very solid 4 star with no disappointment.

We had a reservation and was seated immediately. I was also dressed like a vagrant (t shirt and sweat pants) and didn't get any flak for it despite the place being business casual. Even got some complimentary food, I think it was the duck lasagna and some chocolate balls, not sure if they give those to everyone. The atmosphere is like outback kind of, very noisy, low dim lighting. Service was good, always refilled water, cleared table promptly. I was really excited to try wagyu beef for the first time from watching those food videos on YouTube. We ordered two of the wagyu entrees, 40oz tomahawk steak and the hash browns. Kind of underwhelmed by the wagyu tbh, or maybe my palette isn't refined enough or whatever. Tasted like normal, high quality steak but I really didn't know what to expect. One of the wagyu had a unique funky taste to it. Overall a good experience, I would recommend trying some of this boujee food if you're curious. But be warned it's not that a5 Japanese Kobe wagyu that's hyped on social media.

We celebrated our anniversary tonight and thoroughly enjoyed our dinner. Service was exceptional, very attentive and warm. We received a special appetizer from the kitchen for our celebration dinner. Sweet and welcomed touch. We shared the chateaubriand, cauliflower, meatball app and chocolate chip cookie desert! Everything was delicious!

We went the past two Christmas Eve's, we've been trying to find a solid new Christmas Eve spot ever since Angelo & Maxie's closed. We liked he non-traditional steakhouse vibe and the food was good the first year but it seems the focus is much less on the steak and the quality has seemed to deteriorate. My dad ordered a steak, that the year before was a lovely cut and the past year came as thin as a half inch and the size of a hand. It was bizarre, it looked like something meant to be discarded they accidentally plated. I know steakhouses salt their food like there's no tomorrow but even for me, someone with a 'salt-tooth' I felt myself swelling up as I was eating it. 

Great spot for drinks, staff was quite lovely and knowledgeable but I wouldn't recommend the food.

Went to Bowery Meat Company for dinner on Sunday night. I was not impressed with the offerings and the high prices did not help.

Quality: While the prices were high and the service was poor, it was the quality at Bowery Meat Company, which was most disappointing to me. And I think it really goes to an over-seasoning issue. Our meal began with the Hand-Cut Steak Tartare, which missed a prime opportunity to showcase high-quality meat. Instead they loaded the tartare with heavy seasoning, capers, and onions. Add in the burnt bread, and you could hardly taste the meat at all. Our mains were the Bone In Filet Mignon, the better of the two, but still overloaded with garlic, and the Bowery Steak, too fatty for my taste and overwhelmed by the salsa verde. I believe steakhouses should emphasize the meat, however the push for sauces and seasoning hides the potential here. As a side we also had the Sour Cream & Onion Hash Brown. A perfectly fine side, but I think the other potato dishes would have been better.
Quantity: The portion sizes are large and a single steak can be shared by two.
Value: $23 for Hand-Cut Steak Tartare. $56 for the Bone In Filet Mignon 14oz. $59 for the Bowery Steak. $12 for the Sour Cream & Onion Hash Brown.
Ambiance: Bowery Meat Company is an upscale steakhouse located in Lower Manhattan. When you enter you will find a gorgeous bar on the right and then the dining room area spread across the left. Booths line the windows and several large tables sit at the center of the space. Candles flicker on each table and bottles of wine are displayed across the room. Industrial elements, such as the light fixtures, add some character to a rather generic space. The music was instrumental with some Latin flare.
Crowd: Not packed, but still pretty busy on Sunday night. A diverse crowd with families, couples, and two large groups of friends.
Service: Rarely saw our server and had to ask another waiter for our check.
Parking: Limited street parking in the area.

My boyfriend and I decided to try this restaurant to celebrate his birthday. We had an excellent  experience dining here. Our server, Lindsay, was very attentive and kind. Everything we had was delicious! My favorite items were the ricotta and the creamed spinach. My boyfriend's bone-in filet was fantastic and cooked to perfection. We can't wait to come back!

Very classy and fancy indoors, the ambience is just right- whether you're doing dinner for work or a date.. Chef Capon and his staff are very accommodating! They had music playing too. I had a booth seat near the front. 

My favorite is the broiled oysters, crunchy and smooth in every bite. The duck lasagna was superb- I never had a lasagna with duck before, it was very well cooked w/ the right amount of cheese. The home made ricotta with pomegranate on top is also my fav! Such flavor. I had the Tomahawk Ribeye 40 oz with shishito peppers and onions-- warning these peppers are fire! I almost died eating them by accident, however I'm still a fan of them. This steak was great! I also had a bite of the Wagyu Rib cap steak. Both steaks were medium rare, fulfilling dishes. 

For dessert, I especially wanted the bread pudding, even the waitress recommended it to me, but came back to say that they were all out. Hence why I gave 4 stars, I settled for the chocolate cheesecake, which was ok.

Highly recommend Bowery Meat Company. Our waiter, Delance, was absolutely amazing. He gave us the duck lasagna, mushrooms, and salted caramel chocolate balls on the house. All of it was amazing. He also brought an amazing Oreo ice cream cake for my birthday that was to die for. Delance was very attentive and answered all of our questions. Our meal was amazing. The best part was definitely the lobster Mac and Cheese. The best in the city. Will definitely be visiting again!!

First time here having an 11 person dinner for my birthday. The staff was extremely welcoming and helpful; the hostess and bartenders taking plenty of photos of our party; the female bartender who got me some complimentary salami chips for my birthday; the sommelier helped me pick out just the wine I was looking for; the waiter and busboy service was excellent; and the food was delicious. Very good steak that was cooked excellently and not too heavy

Visiting NYC for the weekend and came  with my husband for date night. Made our reservation in advance. Service was good and so was the food but definitely over priced. Everything is a la carte. Nice experience and glad we tried it. But this is a one and done for us.

Great place to take visitors. The food was fantastic and they even had a selection of options for vegetarians which I wasn't expecting. They have this giant cookie you have order for dessert which I highly recommend.

I can't say anything about the food because we never got to the table. Seventy-five minutes after our reservation, after being told several times we'd be sitting in 10 minutes, after a perceptible malaise among the host staff, we left. It sucked.

Excellent! 

The space is beautiful with a really nice bar and awesome booths. The servers were excellent and made sure everything was perfect.  We had two steaks one was perfect the other which was the bone-in filet was a touch over but still great. Salad was excellent and a nice bottle of wine. 

Thanks to the team working there and we will be back
Wow. Not worth it.  Boyfriend is a fierce steak eater but my gosh. Our steaks were burnt :,(. But the mushroom side was dope.

This is our family's favorite restaurant for special occasions.  The food is absolutely delicious.  The service is outstanding.  The vibe is casual.  Is it expensive?  Yes.  But we always feel like we get what we pay for.

I usually go to steakhouses in Midtown, but based on reviews and several YouTube videos, decided to try something different. 

All I can say is it was very underwhelming.  More hype then substance.  My go to steak is always a nice inbone ribeye, but based on the reviews and the videos, I decided to try their Chateaubriand 20 oz.  The steak was perfectly cooked to our desired temperature, but it ended there.  This piece of meat had no flavor whatsoever.  I know that some people will say I should have known better, but if you are paying close to $140 for a piece of meat you expect the chef to do some magic.

What I really don't understand is, if you are billing yourself as one of the top steak houses in NYC, with plenty of competition, why would you put a piece of meat on the menu and not give it any flavor. Now I would think if I am paying $140 dollars, I would at least get a sauce of some kind, this is where you would be mistaken.  The house sauce was $3... :-).
Personally I am a purist, salt and pepper nothing else. A good steak should stand on its own and no sauces should be required.  

We also had the salmon which was very good and full of flavor which is why the three stars.  My expectation however is if I go to a steakhouse and I order one of their signature dishes, I expect to be wowed, instead I was disappointed.

Overall it was an okay experience, the waist staff was friendly and the atmosphere is nice.  I might go back to try another cut, but to be honest there is so much better competition and this place doesn't break the top 5 for me.

I've recently came back to New York and decided to try this place out for my friends birthday dinner. We arrived pretty much on time for our reservation which was for 6:30 PM on December 28th. 

First thing that I noticed was this place was severely warm, meaning you don't need a jacket for sure and you could probably be wearing something that seems like summer and be fine with it. 

Our server was pretty nice even though she was sharing with another server. The tables here are super tight for my liking. But then again we did meet the people sitting next to us and found out that they were from Florida on vacation in the Big Apple. 

We ordered a steak, two side dishes mashed and cream of spinach. Our server told us that it will take 30 minutes for our steak to be done and if we wanted any appetizers to start with. We declined and said no since we really just wanted to enjoy our piece of meat. 

Before our food arrived, our server had decided to send us a dish comped to try. It was pretty tasty with pomegranate on it and a side of sliced bread. 

Overall our dining experience was really good and it was just a fun diner. But one of the other servers was quite rude, and decided to remind me to "Not take his photo", hello we weren't taking your photo, it is the photo with all the meat on it. Literally just wanted to show it for Yelp. I was a little shocked and taken back because I've been to plenty of nice restaurants and have never heard anyone remind a guest to not take a photo of his face. 

Besides that event our dinner was mainly enjoyable. But overall that's why this place isn't a 5 star for sure.

We wanted to eat meat, and chose Christmas eve dinner 2019 in NYC. Happy Valley Meats Grassfed Bone-In NY Strip 18oz, which we chose was soooo delicious and feel healthy !! Atmosphere was also good. More than anything, Stuff's service was great comfortable. The best Christmas eve dinner than I've ever take !!

Wow. I used to live in Texas, so I know a good steak when I taste one. The 100-Day Dry-Aged Double Ribeye is the most spectacular cut I've had in a long time.  Bravo.

If you're looking at the menu in advance of a reservation and getting a little squeamish at the price tag, this is my advice: quality goods come at a premium price. Sure, there are plenty of steakhouses in the city that have 32oz steaks under $165. But once you take that first bite pure 100-Day aged bliss, you'll know where that extra money went.
An absolutely amazing dining experience. They are so warm. Everyone that works there makes you feel so welcomed and then they feed you the most amazing dinner you may ever have!

AMAZING! I went to Bowery Meat Company with five friends on a Friday night. Fortunately we had a reservation because the restaurant was quite busy. We decided to eat family style and got two orders of their Whipped Potato Puree ($12 each), one order of their Grilled Neuske Bacon ($24 each), Duck Lasagna ($58), and two 40 oz Tomahawk Ribeyes with Market Onions ($172 each). Honestly, one Tomahawk Ribeye would've sufficed. Everything was DELICIOUS! Their potato puree was creamy and tasteful, the bacon was incredibly flavorful, and their duck lasagna was DIVINE! Lasagna noodles cooked perfectly and the duck...COOKED TO PERFECTION! Don't even get me started on the Ribeyes! Cooked beautiful with so much flavor! Our waiter was also extremely knowledgeable in all the cuts of meat and their entire menu. I also liked the restaurant's match books they have at the front. A nice little "going away" present :). I will DEFINITELY be back!

Amazing atmosphere, delicious food, and great service! Had a large party and was seated at circle table...although it would have been nice to get a slightly bigger table, the food made up for! Definitely a place to try!!!

This place is amazIng. The staff is very helpful and polite. The food is  amazing. I never had an issue with anything I have ever ordered either food  or drinks from here. I totally recommend this restaurant to anyoone looking to have a great night with food  and drinks.

Starters were good but Steaks were huge disappointment. We ordered the Bowery "Rib-Cap" Steak and Snake River Farms Denver Steak 8 oz. rib Cap was not very flavorful and not as tender as expected. Denver steak was very tough to cut and chew.

Held a 20 person client dinner here in the private room. Everything was 5 stars from the beginning of my inquiry, to the food, to the service. So impressed. Will definitely be my #1 for client dinners moving forward!

Really amazing meal and service, from start to finish. As soon as you walk in there's a fairly spacious bar area, and the host stand right next to the entrance. (There is a coat check.)

Dining area is spacious as well, as well is an enclosed room that would work well for private events. 

Good options for wines by the glass, there is a bar menu as well. We got to snack on some yummy chips before sitting down at our table. 

The bread they bring out is delicious. If you haven't had the duck lasagna, I think they will offer you a taste of it on the house. It's funny because it's listed on the menu to serve 2-8 people, all for the same price of $58. Guess it depends on how hungry you are, or how much of it you plan on eating, but it's delicious. We also ordered the duck wings which were amazing and packed with flavor. 

Steak was cooked perfectly at medium rare. Highly recommend the citrus brussel sprouts and the sour cream and onion potato sides with your steak. The potato was so delicious, and tasted like a real life version of the sour cream and onion chip. 

Desserts: loved the chocolate chip cookie skillet, which was essentially very similar to a pizookie from BJ's. The cookies and cream ice cream cake was amazing as well, just had to wait a bit for it to soften as it came frozen. 

Extensive wine menu, and they have a sommelier who can help with guiding you. Would definitely come back, and probably with a bigger group too to get the full duck lasagna.

Wow - this was a phenomenal meal. The only reason I'm giving 5 stars is because we made a reservation at 8pm for 8-10 people and didn't get seated until 9pm.... when we did get sat. There wasn't enough room for our party. HOWEVER, Bowery made up for this by bringing our table 2 of the ricotta pomegranate starters on the house AND gave us a complimentary bread pudding for the table at the end of the meal for dessert. The bread pudding is to die for and shareable for up to 8 people. Highly recommend!

Shared the porterhouse steak 40oz (med rare) with sautéed spinach. Steak was cooked perfectly and it was tender. The fattier pieces of the steak melted in your mouth. No tough or chewy-ness. We had an array of sauces at the table to try with our steaks. I recommend getting the hash browns as a side. Probably the best hash brown dish I've ever had. 

Oysters from the sea food tower had options of east coast on one side and west coast on the other. The shrimp were huge! 

Definitely a pricey dinner for the amount of people and food but worth every penny. There are a ton of great steak options and i hope to come back and try a different cut of meet next time. Great cocktails as well :)

I love this restaurant. Every time we're in New York, we have to make a stop. I love how they'll showcase the meat to you raw and allow you to see what you're getting! We got both the double aged ribeye and the porter house. The service here is impeccable and they even gave us complimentary appetizers because the wait was a little long before we got our steaks. Great atmosphere, very cozy, and we'll be back!

I love steak a lot. I had a hard time thinking of something more original to start this post off with. However, I figured let me not bury the lead here. This is the second time my wife and I have been at BMC. It's become an almost de facto spot for us to celebrate any special occasion. Now I've been on a diet so I was ready for cheat night a little more than usual this week. As always the place is bustling with noise and smells of meaty goodness. We scored a corner booth table which was awesome and proceeded to be greeted by our waitress who was awesome. Her name was Yuliya I believe. Great recommendations from her and it was the tomahawk ribeye for the win w/ Au poivre sauce. As an app we got the lobster Mac and Cheese. It was a little salty but good nonetheless. And an order of fries and sour cream hash brown. Now let me bring it back full circle to the steak. The steak was cooked perfectly. We wanted it medium and we got it MEDIUM. It literally melted in our mouths. I mean I left there feeling like this was once again worth the trip over the bridge. Great spot year over year.

Went here with coworkers and this was absolutely delicious. I would recommend reservations. The ambience is fancy but modern and you could wear casual if you want. There is a coat check too. Manny was our waiter and he was lovely. We ended up starting with the lobster mac which was the best I ever had. And the salad, which also was good! I never am that impressed with salads though, thats just me. 

We got the tomahawk to share (3 people) bc honestly who can eat that much meat and we finished it. SO GOOD. Then got the mashed potatoes which you need to get. Their sauces are also phenomenal. We ordered the fries but didn't need them. Also got a sundae at the end that was lovely. Service was overall great. We got a bottle of the sparkling which I quite enjoyed too. Not cheap, but worth it.

I came here the day after Valentine's Day with my girlfriend. We had an order of east point Blue Oysters as an appetizer which was delicious after not having oysters for many years. My girlfriend had the Prime New York Strip while I had the Bone-In Prime Ribeye, with a side of smashed potatoes (which they were kind enough to give on the house). Let me just say this was one of the best meals I've ever had, i only wish I had more of an appetite. And for dessert (which I somehow had room for) we had an amazing Blueberry Cheesecake with graham cracker crust. Highly recommend coming here and would definitely come back!

One of the best Steakhouses in New York. We tried the Duck Lasagna which was amazing. The fried Oysters are must try. The food overall is outstanding as well as the service. Great variety of steaks to chose from. We had the Sirloin for two which was great. We will definitely be back.

Love this place! Went with a party of 8 and they gave me substitutions free of charge (however the meal was expensive) for every item I couldn't have because I have Celiac Disease. The hospitality and service is outstanding every time I go. I will continue going back for years.

Had reservations here to celebrate my birthday with my boyfriend and we both enjoyed it! We ended up sharing a New York Strip, potato purée, and the creamed spinach. I like how the New York Strip was cooked and it was the perfect amount for us. The server also gave us a complementary taste of the Duck Lasagna which was really tasty.

The entire staff was really friendly and attentive. Price point of their menu is pretty comparable to other steakhouses we have back in LA so i would definitely recommend coming here!

I finally made it to this hyped up restaurant.  This hyped up steakhouse is also a celebrity spot. It is a great spot for group dining.  There are a lot of men that dined here. They have happy hour, which is reasonably priced. For happy hour, I got the refreshing Bauhaus cocktail ($13). 

Food and service was amazing. When we were seated the knowledgable server greeted us with a selection of steaks to order from.  We decided to go family style after observing other diners' main order entrees.  To start we ordered the:

House made Ricotta ($20): Great start to the meal journey  

Kung Pao Duck Wings ($21): Pricey for an appetizer order, luckily the waiter was nice enough to provide extra pieces so each one of us would have a piece. The wings overall was crispy but the least favorite among the dishes. 

Baby Gem Salad ($19): Standard salad, definitely need some greens but could do without it. 

Tomahawk Ribeye ($172): This dish was the highlight and star of this meal journey. This steak was tender and cooked perfectly. No wonder why celebrities rave about this dish. Definitely worth the splurge but go with at least five people, remember portion control. 

Porterhouse ($159):  This steak was tender and cooked perfectly. What was good about this dish was the thickness of the steak. Unsure if it was worth the splurge to me it was standard, but go with at least five people, remember portion control. 

We also ordered a side of Crispy Brussels Sprouts ($14), which was pricey for the small portion.  We also got the salt and pepper fries ($12) which was so good and a decent portion size. 

For dessert my friend ordered the cookies and cream ice cream cake ($13) which was huge and made for sharing. 

Overall meal cost was over $500 because people ordered drinks.  Personally I would love to return one more time for happy hour to try the duck lasagna, steak frites and burger. Praying that this pandemic will be over so I can venture out there again :-)
Outstanding steaks and great service. Came for birthday and they even hooked us up with some free apps and sides. Highly recommend, great atmosphere. Get the Porterhouse for 2

They did a really good job with their outdoor dining.  The tables are not too close together.  The structure was nicely constucted.
Staff appreciated the diners and the business.  Very attentive service.
Food was great.  They were very generous with portions. Steak cooked to right temp.  
The brick Chicken was juicy and tender.  Even the white meat was juicy. 
Will definitely return.

Went here on a date night and it did not disappoint. We ordered the Ricotta and bacon for starters. The bacon was alright, not sure I'd order it again. The ricotta was amazing, worth the price for sure. For dinner we had the 40 oz Porterhouse. It was a fantastic cut of meat. It was thick, well seasoned, and cooked to perfection. We also ordered the Fingerlings which were pretty good. It was plenty of food for two people. We actually both took some home for lunch and it reheated surprisingly well for a delicious steak lunch.

I've been wanting to try this spot out for the longest. I brought my boyfriend here for his birthday. My boyfriend and I both ordered the ribeye which came with shishito peppers. I ordered my steak rare and he ordered his medium rare. I prefer my steak between medium rare to rare and mine was cooked to perfection. His steak came out medium but he didn't mind it. It's my first time having steak with peppers and I'm personally not a huge fan of the peppers. We ordered a side of whipped mash and it was delicious. Blueberry cheesecake was the perfect way to finish up dinner. Service was phenomenal.

After receiving a last minute cancellation to our original reservation (due to an update in their operating hours), I was left feeling disappointed and without a reservation for a special 30th birthday dinner. 

Upon my disappointment, I received a personal apology (via email and a phone call) from the manager - Cesar, along with an invitation to revisit. 

We had such a pleasant and dining experience and could not be more appreciative of the exemplary customer service from Cesar and the entire staff. The outdoor dining set up is very chic and inviting.  They have a covering in case it rains, and beautiful string lights set up. The waiters and waitresses were extremely knowledgeable with the menu and each cut of meat and also very friendly. The food was phenomenal. I highly recommend the whipped ricotta, broiled oysters, porterhouse for two, and the cacio e pepe fingerling potatoes. 

After originally feeling dissatisfied and displeased, I could not be more impressed by the service and accommodations with the entire BMC staff. Special shoutout to Devone the general manager who also made the night very special. Thank you for inviting us to return, and also thank you for treating us so well. I cannot wait to come back and dine with my friends and family. 

I highly recommend this restaurant for a special occasion or group dinner. Delicious food that isn't your typical/ boring steakhouse options, and amazing service. Thank you Cesar and Devone!

Although the appetizers were good, the service was not. Our waitress started rushing us to order the second we sat down. When she felt like we had taken too long, she insisted she wanted the entire order taken at once and would not budge on that. She then proceeded to recommend we order an obscene amount of food saying that it was enough for a table of 7 and directing us to the most expensive things on the menu. Thankfully, we canceled one of the entrees, but food was still leftover. 
It is a shame because the host and the bus boys were very friendly, but it was hard to enjoy my meal when I was being rushed and manipulated into ordering way more than necessary. 
The meat was okay.

During COVID: This restaurant offers individual wrapped blankets for outdoor seating!  This is above and beyond service.  Shows me management cares.  And their food matches this excellent service.  Appetizers, steaks, salmon, wine were all lovely and the DESSERT! I had highhh expectations for the warm
cookies and ice cream we ordered and these chocolate chip cookies did not disappoint. I wanted to walk inside and thank the chef myself.  Love this restaurant!!!

I have been to this place many times.  It used to be good.  This is the first time i go there during COVID.  Here are my thoughts:
Positives:
- Seating outside was pleasant and comfortable
- Service (our waitress) was great!

Negatives:
- Food was average at best
- Grossly overpriced.  Four people $800 bill and we barely got each 3-4 oz of meat... The 40oz Tomahawk is barely 12-15 oz of edible meat for $179.  No matter how you cut it, it is absurd (and it was not even tasty).

Overall, very poor proposition.  I love eating out and support NYC restaurants.  I am ok with the 10% COVID surcharge and all that BUT I am not ok paying $550 (excluding Wine) to get 1 piece of meat, 1 Lasagna, and 2 appetizer/sides.

Great food. The procedure for covid while ordering and checking out is beyond annoying.  People need to get a understanding of the actual severity of this virus and get over it. Otherwise I can't express how great our meal was.
Everything about this place is right. The food was truly unbelievable as were the drinks and the atmosphere. Great outdoor dining for covid.

Absolute great meal and great time!  Myself (Murray) and friend Kim went here Monday October 26th and had a great night.  
From the beginning with Carey helping us through the wine list and suggesting starters while we were getting seated to Manny's excellent service.   The whole experience was top notch.
We decided to go with the Tomahawk with sides of mash potatoes (steakhouse staple) and some great lobster Mac.   Goes without saying the food is remarkable, but I will say it anyways!  Our Sommelier Andres was also present suggesting great wines (I went with the Caymus) and asking how everything was tasting.
From start to finish we were floored with the great service, excellent advice, and overall great time we had on a rainy Monday night.  Anytime I am back in the city I will definitely make a point to book another reservation or two.  Thanks once again to everyone FOH and BOH for making the total experience memorable.

Excellent meal with excellent service. The entire experience from start to finish was exceptional. Ate here last night for my son's 14th birthday. Our server (Delance sp?) was so attentive and friendly. Ribeyes came out perfect as well as my wife's lobster tail special. Although there are no heat lamps, fleece blankets are provided to keep you warm. The blankets come in sealed plastic bags like on an airplane so that you feel safe and clean. This was our first time dining here but we will be back!

A lovely steakhouse with many delicious options on the menu. Lobster Mac and cheese was insanely yummy. Loved the 100 days dry aged steak, whipped potatoes, and creamed spinach. Finished off dinner with an incredible cheesecake! Highly recommend this great steakhouse!

Yesterday a dined here for my 10 year anniversary. We didn't make reservations but was offered to eat inside or out. The decor was really nice and warm. The waiter and manager was so nice and helpful. This place is not cheap but In my opinion the food was phenomenal I enjoy everything about this place and will be returning.

I came here for my boyfriends birthday. I was blown away by not just the food but the service as well. Our server, Carrie, was amazing. Her recommendations on drinks, appetizers, entrees, desserts, were on point. Her welcoming spirit and knowledge about the menu really made the difference in exploring what the restaurant had to offer. We ordered a couple bottles of Syrah, oysters, ricotta appetizer, ribeye, brick chicken and the cheesecake dessert. Carrie really took our dining experience to the next level. We will definitely come back  to the restaurant to try other items on the menu.

Great attentive staff and team at Bowery Meat Company. A true pleasure dining in during covid times. The wait staff to the manager to the front and back of the house. Prime example of excellent customer service. 

Appetizers 
Kung Pao Duck Wings 

Main
Porter House for two

Sides
Brussel Sprouts
Sautéed Spinach 
Ciao de Peppe Potatoes 

Wines the Half Bottle of Cab was great.

Had Thanksgiving dinner here this year. Overall, I was a fan of the portions of the food, but everything this evening was salty. I normally am very heavy-handed with salt, so for me to comment that it was salty, means it was extra salty. The toasted bread with pomegranate ricotta was a nice starter, and lobster Mac & cheese was  yummy as well, just salty. The whipped potatoes and creamy spinach were delicious as well, just a tad bit salty. I ordered the 20OZ bone-in ribeye, which was cooked to perfection. I didn't mind the salt on the dish, it was so delicious!!!! The cardamom cocktail was also refreshing!
I had food delivered and let me tell you the food was great. I had steak,whipped potatoes, and creamed spinach.

My girlfriend and I came to Bowery Meat and sat outside for NYE. The food was delicious, and the waitress Lauren R was kind and excited to serve us. Made our experience that much better! We hope to be back soon. Highly recommend the duck lasagna.

My husband and I had a great meal at Bowery meat company. We started off with the homemade ricotta cheese and it was so good. It tasted fresh, the bread that came with it was perfectly crispy but also chewy and the pomegranate seeds were a nice touch. We also got the steak tartare on crispy rice which was also amazing. I wish it came with 1 more piece but I would definitely recommend getting this. We then shared the porterhouse which was great. The side with filet mignon was amazing so I would probably get a filet mignon the next time. The creamed spinach was one of the best I've had and the potatoes cacio e Pepe style were amazing. We also ended with the warm chocolate chip cookies which were great.

Came here for a date night and it did not disappoint! Great service, which I find harder to come by during Covid, and absolutely fantastic food. Everything we ordered was wonderful; I can't even say what I liked best because it was all so great. Can't wait to come back!

The places is very romantic for dates if you like. 
The services is excellent, the staff is very friendly and recommend what to order for you first time there. 
The tomahawk steak was cooked to perfection for medium term as we ordered. Definitely coming back and totally recommended.

This time around I tried this place for take out. What a nice surprise. It exceeded my expectations and already ordered twice. Not only the food was prepared perfectly but the service was very nice. The salmon was good size and cooked exactly how I wanted. Everything was This is the kind of place I would want to come back to.

Prices are insane even by steak houses standard . Also they add 10% Covid relief charge that the clueless mayor introduced , most restaurants don't add it cause they know it's a classless thing todo . I know when I hi to steak houses it's not cheap and expect to pay a lot . But these place isn't even that good . 170 for rib eye steak for 2 ? 35 dollars lobster Mac and cheese . 30 dollars for a mediocre burger . I understand restaurants are struggling right now but don't rape the people who want to support you . Do yourself a favor and take that Covid relief charge off the menu , it's not even the money it's just not the right thing todo and they clearly write underneath it this is not for the staff ?? So what there saying is please also tip the staff . Which off course deserves it . Won't be back
This place was very ok and also very expensive.  Steaks dry.  Weird covid surcharge (just raise prices, that's fine).  There's just not much to say.

Such an amazing menu and gracious hospitality. You get what you pay for. Definitely not an inexpensive steakhouse but anyone going Morton's, Homestead or Peter Lugars should not be shocked. Heading there for a second time tonight.

Love, love, love this place! Ambiance, service, cocktails, wine, and of course food are all outstanding. 

Order steak, some apps, some sides and you're golden. Four of us ordered the following: chopped salad, broiled oysters, duck wings, rib cap (special), tomahawk for two, porterhouse for two, Brussels sprouts, whipped potatoes, chocolate chip cookies, chocolate lava cake, cocktails, one bottle of white and one bottle of red. We left very full, very buzzed and very happy. 

Come here for an occasion or a special night out and you won't regret it. You'll be taken care of and have a fantastic meal.

This was highly recommended by my cousin and was a really good hip steakhouse. The bone in rib-eye was cooked perfectly for me at medium and the side of crispy fingerling potatoes was my favorite except which there was no cheese. Don't really recommend the lobster Mac and cheese because I think the lobster tasted fishy. 

The ambiance is great and it's a spacious place.

And it doesn't smell intensely like a steakhouse 

I recommend

The outdoor space is nice and very warm if you get a table under the tent (warm enough to go coat off). The hospitality was welcoming and helpful. My main qualms revolve around the food -- everything was just OK and frankly disappointing, but perhaps that was because the hype around this spot is so high. If I didn't know better, I would've believed you if you told me the food was prepared by one of those suburban restaurant chains. We ordered the 40oz porterhouse for two, the fingerling potatoes, broiled oysters, and some red wine. All in all, I would say I was disappointed to have paid a pretty penny for a squarely mediocre meal (although the dining experience was great). 

We asked for a recommendation for the starters, and were told that the broiled oysters were "the best thing on the menu." When they arrived, I was surprised by how charred (read: burnt) they looked. Each of the six oysters were quite large, and the seasoning was very garlicky and buttery -- reminded me of overly greasy garlic bread. While I enjoyed it, I was shocked that this dish was considered "the best thing on the menu"...but I think it was accurate, unfortunately for us.

The porterhouse was not well seasoned. Despite being very sensitive to salt, I found myself needing to request a side of salt so that we could season it ourselves. There were also parts that were overly charred (read: burnt, again) and not edible. The fingerling potatoes were neither crispy nor flavorful. We did not finish the potatoes.

While we were full by the end of the meal, the enjoyment factor could have been higher. Did we order the wrong things? Perhaps. But I think it's fair to judge a steak house by their porterhouse and potatoes.

My friends and I are in from out of town this restaurant was recommended by our hotel. It was hands down the best dinner I have ever had! Everything was delicious! Everything we ordered had such amazing flavor we couldn't stop eating. Will definitely be going back!

After we left, the waiter flagged us down outside and accused us of shorting him $89.  Turns out *HE* screwed up and gave us the wrong check in the first place.  The food was good but we left feeling grifted

It's been a hot minute since I've gone and really enjoyed a nice dinner at a fine dining restaurant. Probably a year? Came to Bowery Meat Company for a double dinner date with another couple. The service, food, everything was stellar from the getgo. 

Service:
We were commuting in from Queens and decided to try and go early and grab some drinks at the bar. Our hostess mentioned they aren't providing that option at this time but were more than willing to sit us down. We asked to be placed in this nice covered patio outdoor space where we could get fresh air and they were more than happy to accommodate. There were heat lamps and the openings could be covered if the weather got too cold or rainy. Our waiter was more than accommodating and checked up on us very frequently. They had bus boys, water boys, the full staff to serve us comfortably. 

Ambiance:
Very comfortable, spacious and not overly shoulder to shoulder like some places. They provided indoor and outdoor options so make sure you specify when you reserve on Resy. We went with the covered patio area which had plenty of heat lamps and the flexibility to close up the window openings if needed. 

Food: 
I know this is a steak joint, but we came for the burger. SPOILER ALERT: It was glorious! : ) We shared a lot of apps and everything was delicious and on point. 

*Jumbo Shrimp Cocktails - Came in a set of (4) shrimps. It was on ice and delicious as is. Nothing fancy, just classic done right. 

**Kung Pao Duck Wings - These were spicy! It came with this creamy ranch style sauce and was a great combination of sweet and spicy. Came in a set of (5) pieces I believe. Duck meat is always so tender and juicy.

***Grilled Nueske Bacon - It had cracked pepper, pickled red pearl onion, moscatel vinegar. A thick piece of bacon done right. I believe it came in (4-5) pieces. 

****BMC Meatballs - Moist, Delicious, meatballs done right. Sits above some creamy polenta and some tomato pan gravy, the entire table went full savage on these when they came out. 

*****BMC Dry Aged Burger - Raclette Cheese, Tomato Aioli, Griddled onions, fries or substitute for any side really. I substituted mine for whipped potatoes. This was a like a punch in your face amazingness. The cheese was so thin and the flavors were so intense. I got my burger medium and there was a slight bit of pink which was perfect for me. HIGHLY recommend this if you're not in the mood for steak or just want a burger done RIGHT. I believe it was made with a brioche bun. 

Summary: 
Great spot for a date night or a couple's date. Despite being a steak joint, they make a burger just as good as any burger connoisseur. I would highly recommend EVERYTHING i listed in the food options with the burger being my top option followed by the duck wings and BMC meatballs. The bacon and cocktails are good but not must haves. They do reservations over RESY and remember to specify if you want indoor or outdoor. I would reserve a week and a half or two weeks in advance to get preference in time.

Huge disappointment between the drink menu , the appetizers , homemade risotto tasted like cream cheese with a few pomegranates pieces , fingerling potatoes foo caca . The steak was good and so was the creamed spinach. Other then that flat out was not happy or impressed by anything on the menu . 
Hostess and waitress were nice people is only reason I have given  two stars !!

Great COVID friendly outdoor dining deck! Amazing ambiance - lots of greenery and very comfortably spaced out w/ overhead heaters. The heaters tend to get a little warm - our entire party was about to doze off towards the end of our meal between the heavy food, heaters from above and pitter patter of the rain :D

Ordered jumbo shrimp cocktail (so plump!), meatballs (sooooo moist), duck wings (crispy skin!), bacon (can't go wrong here!) to start and then got a ribeye and 3 burgers for 4 people. So much food. The burgers come with a MASSIVE amount of fries - and they're perfectly crisp. Excellent waitstaff as well. Highly recommend!
