I came here this past weekend for dinner and had an overall great experience. I sat indoors, which was somewhat distanced and the ambiance was very classic. The waitstaff was incredibly helpful and friendly. I had the kosher steak as my main (which is certified kosher, but cooked on the regular grill) and it was outstanding. There was a perfect crisp to the outside and was nice and moist on the inside. The cacio e pepe potatoes and sautéed spinach were great add ons. The shishitos were good, but not blistered, so I would have liked them to be more cooked. For dessert, I had the chocolate chip cookies which were really enjoyable. Overall, I would highly recommend this restaurant!

I'm so happy to have dined here! It's been a little over the year since the pandemic started that our family never dined outside. Yesterday we sent the kids to their grandparents and my husband and I enjoyed a romantic dinner out. The tomahawk was cooked to perfection and our waitress was so nice and recommended us the perfect wine.

Expensive but not that good... fancy but cheap... pretentious but lame;
You know when they have $140 items (yes not one but many) and you end up ordering the cheapest steak because you don't wanna get a 2nd mortgage to pay for dinner that night, and that sucker still sets you back $64 (plus tax) you'd expect one of the finest cuts at least in the last few days.
Well my friends the pictures do not lie, this thin -not even 3/4 of an inch-intent of a New York Strip was hard to chew, well that would have to do with them over cooking it... i know, I know, but I did order medium, that piece of chewy matter (see attached pic) is well overdone.
In their defense their $19 Caesar Salad is very tasty and huge, good enough for two, and the service even tough scarce, is very good, they go the extra mile to make sure you are happy... probably they would have redone my steak if i had complained about it being overcooked but it was so thin and tasteless that I didn't want to wait for that. 
Then drinks were really good (hence the two stars) well mixed and handsomely served, go barkeeps, yey!

Haven't been in a couple years but it was just as good, if not BETTER than last time! Went with a group of 10 to celebrate a sister's birthday and the service was GREAT!!! The duck lasagna is an incredibly solid, delectable dish. It's a lot of duck meat so you may have leftovers for home. It's also big enough for 6 to try and 3 to be satisfied with it as a meal. We also ordered a porterhouse for the table. Pricy, but well seasoned and prepared at a great temp (medium). The broiled oysters are a definite go as well. The servers wore masks the entire time, no noses sticking out from under and everyone was respectable and treated us with dignity. Hefty bill but we tipped rather well too. Thank you BMC for your wonderful service and delightfully prepared meals!

This had been my go-to steakhouse in the city for a time. I randomly stumbled upon this restaurant when a vendor took me out for dinner. Maybe because it was free, the New York steak I had was so perfectly cooked and delicious that I came back again and again and again.

However, since the pandemic, I have noticed that the quality has been less consistent, depending on which cut you get. To be safe, the snake farm American Wagyu had been fantastic every time I've had it, though it is around $250. The USDA prime options can be hit or miss. Last time I came with 8 friends and among all the steaks we had, half of them were kind of dry and overcooked, despite asking for medium rare for all steaks. The only steak that was good was the Wagyu New York steak (but it's really hard to mess up Wagyu).
Love it! Great food and super friendly service! The chateaubriand was superb but don't forget to leave room for the cookies and ice cream!

We just want to say...this experience was A++

My girlfriend and I were celebrating our 1 year anniversary and were expecting a bit more casual ambience albeit you guys surprised us!  We did dress up for the occassion and noticed other patrons that were very casually dressed.  This wasn't a big deal for us by any means but what we will say is that your staff treated us according to the occasion.  Let's start with the hostess...she was very polite and prompt and allowed us to show up 30 min late.  Very accommodating to say the least; we appreciated this!  Next, our waitress: Lauren.  She...was (no, IS)...FANTASTIC!! Even though she didn't have to provide a complimentary appetizer, she did.  We were really impressed and amazed by her consistent professionalism, her genuine care for our experience and transparency in regards to the menu.  Both my girlfriend and I have experience in the customer service field and truly, appreciated Lauren's effort and attention to detail.  Again, the complimentary dish wasn't expected but it was very nice.  Thank you, Lauren! Lastly, your other staff members.  From the gentleman pouring water to the young man that delivered our food to the co-host, they were all friendly, attentive and genuinely nice.  It's evident that The Bowery Meat Company hires for culture fits because you were all consistent and made our 1 year anniversary that much sweeter.  From Reginald and Jennifer, we truly thank you for everything.  Stay safe, stay healthy!

This place is mostly 5 star, but I gave this place a 2 star because of the temperature of the environment. I had reservations at 8:30PM. When I walked in, it was definitely hot inside this establishment. I know it's my decision if I wanted to stay or leave, but we had a party of 14 and unlikely to find another place that will accept us. The atmosphere was very HOT and STUFFY. During the dinner one of our guest asked if they could turn the A/C higher, the waitress said it's already on the highest setting. I noticed many patrons, including myself wiping sweat off our heads. The temperature of your environment highly affects the overall experience in a restaurant of this caliber. Imagine eating your perfectly cooked steak, from a chef that spent thousands of dollars at culinary school, and be reduced down by HVAC issues. Overall, the food was great if you enjoy your steak with a complementary side of swamp ass. I probably couldn't wait to come back to a place like this, but I couldn't wait to leave.

Atmosphere was very sophisticated and elegant. 5 stars on the service and wait staff. Manager was very kind. Food was DELICIOUS. The caviar was fabulous. I enjoyed everything I had. Wagyu steak was good however wasn't as delicious as the tomahawk they have on the menu. The chocolate chip cookie was a bit too burnt for our taste. Wouldn't order the wagyu or chocolate chip cookie again. However the raw oysters were amazing and the broiled oysters were to die for!!! Would definitely go back. Thank you

Dark and woody, this place reminds you of a large scale 40's speakeasy- very sexy. 

It's filled with your usual wall-street & tech buffs, date night goers. It's a bit pricey but I have to say I was not that impressed with the steak preparation. 

The staff is amazing, kind and extremely well versed with the menu. Our waiter was funny, he had a group of women and I think we were the spiciest things in there lol. 

We decided to go in for the resturant week deal but after chatting with the waiter he explained that we would be much happier if we ordered individual items outside of the (RWM). So we decided to take his lead, we ordered the Tomahawk cooked (Med-rare), broiled shisito peppers, mac-n-cheese, heirloom tomato's with ricotta, and Brussels sprouts. 

Can I say I really enjoyed literally ALL of the delicious sides but when it came to the Tomahawk it left much to be desired. Slightly tender and lacking flavor but I  just.... I wish it was better. 

All of our cocktails were delicious, hats off to the bartender! 

We ended our night with laughs, great service and a tasty cheesecake to share.

first time here after seeing it on social media's (tiktok) and friend's instagram. i ordered the filet mignon, potatoes. the rest of the party got chicken, salmon and oysters as appetizers. service was great, as expected from high end restaurants like this one. however, the food was so salty, from the filet mignon to the potatoes, it was like the chef didn't know what other spices to use and just use salt instead (we got creamed spinach as a complimentary, and thank god they did). would i come back? that's 50/50, but it was a good experience otherwise.

I have been wanting to come here for sometime now so when I saw it on the Restaurant Week website,  I grabbed my friend to go indulge. Although the RW menu was great, we actually decided to go with the regular menu. 
We shared the broiled oysters and duck wings and for dinner I had the Rib Cap steak, something I've never seen on any other steakhouse menu and a highly prized cut from the top of the ribeye. 
Everything was nothing short of outstanding and the service was very kind and attentive. A wonderful visit and not the last one.

I have ordered a NY strop medium rare and when I got my meat, it was a bit overcooked and the crust was burnt. Overall the meat quality was normal but the service here was very good. All the servers were nice.
Everything is perfect at this downtown restaurant.  I've been here a few times and they never disappoint.  The service is great and the food is delicious.   I would highly recommend!

Came here with my girlfriend after I suggested she pick a place to go grab dinner. I thought the prices were quite high, even for a Manhattan steakhouse. However, I was optimistic this would be the best steak I've had in a very very long time, and I wanted to treat my girl to a nice date. 

We started off with drinks and the broiled oysters which were very tasty. Slightly burnt with lots of butter and garlic, they hit the spot. I ordered the 10 oz filet($63) and she had the 20oz bone in ribeye($64). Both our steaks were perfectly cooked, and we also had the mashed potatoes and green beans as sides. I was a bit surprised that the price of the steak didn't include any sides. 
Overall the steaks were good, but not the best I've ever eaten. Sides were yummy, and the drinks we had were outstanding. 

The main reason I gave 4 stars is the exceptional service we received from our waiter. He was very helpful to us in deciding what to order, and was very charming and funny. We came in late and sat outside, probably keeping him and the other staff there later than needed. So thank you sir, and next time I will check the menu out before I arrive! Rookie mistake. Cheers

Stopped in to have dinner here twice while in the area , the service is great , Freindly and knowledgeable customer service , servers and sommelier . Delicious steaks full of flavor and cooked perfectly. We enjoyed the wine selections .

Food was delicious and the service was awesome - very friendly, knowledgeable wait staff who is attentive without being overbearing. It's pricey but all steakhouses are, and I liked that it was classy without xeeling stuffy. Great for a special occasion.

Soho, home to Katz's Deli. Let's forgo that massive food coma inducing meat pile with bread included for laughs and go to a more traditional steakhouse.  Enter BMC. Let me cut to the chase and say the 'meat' in BMC was by far was the biggest let down of my multi item meal and thus was an epic fail for me. Everything else was a winner except for the very thing that was supposed to shine. The local oysters (Long Island) were sweet and had the perfect salinity. The Night Vision Goggles (a citrus coconut rum blend) was an excellent cocktail to supplement the surf and turf approach I took. Then comes the ribeye. Overcooked and thin. Flavor was almost there but would have been so much better if it came out of the kitchen the right way. The shashito peppers were beautiful but didn't add anything in terms of spice or heat. So you are better off to just stick to the New York staples if you want an amazing cut of beef. Bowery Meat Company sure looks pretty, but doesn't deliver where it matters.

UPDATE: I forgot they were playing Justin Bieber when we came in. Seriously, who is this place for?

Surprisingly downhill. This used to be THE place we went for very special occasions -- a bachelor party, an awards ceremony, and most recently a birthday.

Despite having a reservation for two, we were sat at a "table" in an auxiliary room, inches from a bussing station. For the first 15 minutes there were people filling jugs of ice water behind my head. When we asked to be moved, they agreed and we returned to our original table to retrieve our drinks (ourselves) and found an open silverware drawer where my head would have been. They *literally needed us to leave our table so they could use this work space.*

While we waited for a promised booth, they sat us at the bar for 30 minutes where the admittedly busy bartender asked us what happened to our table unprompted and when we told them was randomly brusque like we were the ones being unreasonable.

The manager offered a table in "the lounge" -- we never did end up getting a booth in the main room that night.

The two more unique menu items we were looking forward to, the Parker house rolls and hash brown side have been removed from the menu. What remains is exactly what you can get at any other steakhouse -- the food was quite good, but easily acquired elsewhere.

All told, we arrived for our 7:30 reservation and our entree arrived after 9:00. I would've had a second drink, but the server didn't come and asked in time.

In terms of atmosphere, the place where I used to wear a suit for my bachelor parties or anniversary dates now has a lot of blue jeans and tables with kids on a Saturday night. Not prohibited by any means, just a change.

It's a bit paranoid, but I got a vibe that they had an idea of who their VIPs were and decided it didn't include me. In the future I'll probably stick to Quality Meats for the upscale experience or Peter Luger for the nostalgic take.

We had the pleasure of trying this place out during the NYC Restaurant Week this past Winter. We had takeout entrees, consisting of salmon and the really huge meatballs. 

This time we ate in. It was midweek late September, and with the Covid19 numbers coming steadily down, luckily we scored a table for two without reservations in a packed bustling restaurant. The noise level was a bit louder than the background music. 

I had the steak, and my wife ordered the chicken, with a side of string beans. 

My ribeye dish came with some peppers that, as it turned out, were a bit more than just a garnish. Her chicken came with whipped potatoes. Everything was first rate.

Please excuse the photos. They were taken under candle light.

I was really eager to try this place out. I love the idea of a modern take on the classic steakhouse, but I was pretty disappointed overall. The ambience is wonderful and service was okay, but the food was mediocre at best.  

We had the Porterhouse for two which was ordered rare. It was cooked properly on the inside, but the outside was so charred it was almost inedible.  A thick coating of black char really left a figurative and literal bad taste in our mouths. For the prices they're charging, and a business with "meat" in their name, they should definitely be better at cooking beef.  You're much better off letting the pros handle it. Classics like Wolfgang's, Keens, and others are steakhouses that deliver while Bowery Meat Company fell very short.

I was back in town visiting family for the holidays and was delighted to come back to Bowery Meat Company

To start we had the tuna tartare, bmc meatballs, and the homemade ricotta. The tuna was good but nothing fantastic. The meatballs were delicious but I was not the biggest fan of the polenta it came on top of. The ricotta was fantastic, very rich and dense. 

For mains we had the roast chicken, the strip steak, the rib eye, and the tomahawk. The best steak was definitely the rib eye, and my favorite cut of steak is normally the strip. The char on the tomahawk was very intense, the strip was a bit too overcooked, but the rib eye was absolutely delicious. 

On the side we got the whipped potatoes, hash brown, mushrooms, and brussels sprouts. All of them were fantastic and come in portions big enough to share. 

For dessert we had the chocolate peach bread pudding. This was absolutely divine. The ice cream was perfectly melty and worked so well with the decadent warm bread pudding. I couldn't tell there were peaches in there but nonetheless it was still great. 

Overall the atmosphere is great, the food is above average for a NYC steakhouse, but everything is a bit pricey

Great place for a delicious steak dinner! Beautiful ambience with dim lighting, comfy booths, and soft music. Food was super delicious! We shared the ricotta toast (must order!), octopus, bacon, 100 day aged steak, creamed spinach, and hashbrown. We enjoyed everything! Some reviews mentioned the char on the steak- I happen to like that on my steak so I really appreciated it but can definitely see how some would be opposed to it. Service was lovely, everyone was very warm and welcoming.  Definitely recommend for a nice date night!

We ordered a dozen of Oysters (west coast & east coast), the House Made Ricotta Cheese was phenomenal!! Rich and so creamy I highly recommend! Not pictured was the meaty bacon Mac & Cheese, truly delicious. To celebrate we enjoyed the Black Diamond Russian Ossetra Caviar so good!! Personally I love my Caviar with capers it adds for a nice acidity! For our main we devoured a Double Cut American Wagyu NY Strip with creamed spinach, salt & pepper fries, & a hash brown with cream!! Dinner was totally epic! The restaurant was beautiful and the service was priceless! Try this steakhouse if you ever find yourself in the area the food is perfect!

Went here for my birthday during covid in 2021 and i can honestly say that they handled the whole pandemic situation very well and. Their staff was very welcoming and engaging throughout the dining experience. I ordered the filet and my steak was cooked just right ! 

Would certainly recommend

While in town, my boyfriend's sister and her fiance brought us to their favorite steakhouse, which is Bowery Meat Company. We had made reservations for indoor seating and we were seated by the bar area. The seats were extremely close together, and not like the steakhouse area seating. We were basically sitting with another couple and every conversation they were having and we were having intertwined with each other. That was something I didn't enjoy. Also, the seats and tables were so close together. There was barely an opening to get to the booth part of the seating arrangement. This was one time where we all said, maybe we should have selected outdoor dining, as there was more room and it would have amplified our dining experience.

We ended up getting a tomahawk, branzino, mashed potatoes, Brussel sprouts, bernaise, and a bottle of wine. The tomahawk was delicious and came with shishito peppers, which I was excited about and ate a bunch, hoping I didn't get a hot one. I ended up not getting a hot pepper, so it was a success. The branzino was also good, unfortunately, I found a bone in the area I took and one thing I can't stand is finding a bone in my fish. It makes me not eat it anymore. Espresso martinis were also ordered, and they seemed to enjoy them. 

For an app, we also got steak tartare, which was phenomenal. 

It ended up being just under $600 for 4 people.

Made a reservation and was quickly seated. Since the party was 9 we were seated in the lounge away from others people dining in. 

They have a lot of choices which was hard to pick since we can't get everything on the menu. 

We ordered: 
1. Tomahawk ribeye 40 oz -recommend 
2. Porterhouse 40 oz 
3. Japanese A5 wagyu NY strip 6 oz
4.100 day dry aged double Ny strip 34 oz
4. Duck lasagna - recommend 
5. Kung pao duck wings 
6. BMC meatballs - recommend 
7. Grilled Spanish octopus 
8. Mac & Cheese with bacon- recommend 
9. Tuna tartare 
10. Broiled oysters- recommend 
11. Chocolate cake 
12. Apple pie 

The top 5 items I've tried are 1,4,6, 8, 10. 
The Apple pie was so delicious! 
The wagyu was a little bit salty but still worth to try. 
The staff was very nice and informative! Thank you BMC for such a great experience!

I went here last year with my boyfriend to celebrate our anniversary. We specified on the reservation that we were celebrating. The host came over as soon as my boyfriend left to go to the bathroom and began saying extremely inappropriate things to me while giving me his card. I went there to celebrate with my boyfriend, excited to have a night out for the two of us. Once we paid the bill, we decided to confront him and he showed absolutely no remorse for his actions. I won't ever recommend this place to anyone and I'm shocked they have such a creep hosting their guests. 

If I could give it minus 1 star I would.
Came here one year for my husband's birthday and have returned every year since. Excellent service, delicious food. The broiled oysters are my personal favorite.

Listen... prior to coming to this place, I put my heart and soul into the fact that Keens steakhouse was #1 in my heart. After dining at BMC, I have to say, things and opinions may have altered. The quality and taste of food, the ambiance, and the service was incredible. I didn't know what I was getting myself into, but I am so happy I did. If I could describe this place I would say it's a younger version of keens, less old people and more of a cool vibe. And the steak... *licks fingers* 

Now i'm not saying the steak was better than keens, but my heart and head are very confused now!
Love this place.. I've actually dying to eat here since I moved in the area 3 years ago.. Definitely wasn't disappointed.. My server Manny was AMAZING!!!!!

10/10 recommend BMCo. From the starters, to the steak, to the dessert, there wasn't one item we didn't love. 

We began with the Mac n cheese with bacon (delicious), meatballs, & Caesar salad. We then had to duck lasagna, which you would never know was duck & so good. All the various steaks (Wagyu, strip, chateaubriand, & filet) were cooked perfectly. Lastly, the bread pudding was to die for - perfectly undercooked to be so soft. We also had the cookie skillet, which was fine but cooked too much -- we want the gooey cookie. 

Glossed over it but the gin cocktail of The Real Slim was great as well! Quality service where they were attentive but not overbearing.
This is my favorite steakhouse in the whole city. Highly recommend getting their duck lasagna, it's so rich and tasty. The ambiance is also amazing. Great place to go on a date or to go with friends!

First time we went, it was jam packed for Valentines Day. Second time, the manager Cesar was kind enough to seat us at a nice table and stopped by a few times to check in on us. Our server Manny was also fantastic at helping us select our meal. We had the porterhouse and everything from the truffle butter to the sides was perfect. Highly recommend for a dinner date. Great atmosphere, food and service!

Had the perfect birthday dinner with my best girl friends here. Every single thing we ordered was cooked to perfection. From the duck lasagna, the oysters, the salmon, the branzino, the Tomahawk steak, the brussel sprouts, the mac & cheese, all of it was so tasty. The ambiance really sold the deal too. Cozy yet classy and intimate. And whoever was running the playlist deserves an award because they had Jill Scott and Slum Village in rotation all night. Honestly couldn't have asked for a better restaurant experience in NYC. Will definitely come back.

Came to this spot yesterday for a larger group after debating steakhouse's.  We determined BMC because of the size of our group and ambiance and it definitely did not disappoint. Nice lighting low music and plenty of space.  Chairs are a bit weird  though....

Steak: 3/5
As far as presentation goes this place touts their dry age quite a bit and they are not aggressive but definitely try to up-sell to the shared steaks from their cutting board which does lend itself to a nice presentation.  Most folks at our table got a mix of fillet's and the bone in ribeye.  Their butcher selects pretty good cuts and everything is very thick at least 1.5 - 2 " the way it should be.  The quality of the meat was pretty good though likely not grass fed.  The finish was very nice with very charred edges and a decent crust.  However, the gold standard IMO is still Strip House (quality of their meat has gone down but the finish is still the best in the city).  My biggest issue was the toughness on the ribeye, for something that should be so fat layered it was really tough to cut into, it was also tougher on eating.  Not that sort of marbled fall apart piece that you are used to.  I think this is due to the excessive dry age time.  And, it was medium rare.  Also they put shiatsu peppers on top which are nice but totally pointless for no reason than being unique. i would have preferred roasted garlic.  If you are going to get anything dry age from this place that isn't the A5 wagyu, make sure you get it rare.  PLace would have been 5 stars if the steak was better.  I am sure if we actually did get one of the shareables it would have been better, but I am a steak lover and honestly I hate pre-sliced steaks.  
Steak: 3.5/5

Sides/Apps: 4/5
The app's and sides were great. We got the duck lasagna (only get this if you love duck and have a big group), all the potato dishes, brussels's, spinach.  THe best potatoes was the fingerling truffles but only if you like that flavor.  The has was so disappointing. It is a cake that is not crispy.  The brussels were easily the best, charred to perfection with some sweetness.  The mac n cheese presentation was disappointing as it looked a bit small and was done with penne.  But the flavor made it the best side, the cheese is very sharp and VERY strong. Loved it.  

Dessert: 2/5.  
The table got cheesecake (NY style with berries on top), cast iron cookie, and "18 layer cake".  The cast iron cookie was the best and all their gelato is so thick and creamy.  The cake was ultra disappointing, it was small and was more like 1 layer with no distinguishable layers.  I will say the flavor and moistness on the sponge were very good. But, this is NYC if I am going to spend $20 on a slice of cake it needs to be a showstopper.  

 Overall, a great intimate spot for a group.  It doesnt feel as open and massive as Morton's but not so cramped like Quality Eats.  Great presentation and accompaniments.  I think the steaks should be pushed to be one level rarer than you would normally order.  For me the best overall experience is still Strip House

Let me preface with the fact that I've been to several high end restaurants and understand what I'm about to discuss. Went to the BMC on a Monday. Reservations at 7:30. Sat immediately but then waited a while for drink orders. Waitress apologized for wait. Fine, first offense, not a big deal...that is..until it wasn't. We finally got our drinks and ordered 3 appetizers. All were good and arrived timely. Things went down from there. While finishing our apps, we were all done with our initial drinks. Nobody stopped by for another round or even to take our dinner order. After flagging the waitress down, we ordered the second round and our dinners + sides. Dinner arrived. No second round of drinks yet. A side was missing. Drinks finally showed and the waitress mentioned we would not have to pay for the missing side (expected at this point). Finally dessert and drinks. Ordered 2 different desserts yet 2 cast iron cookies came out. No mention of replacement, 86 on the cheesecake or anything. As for the food, the steaks were good but the sides lacked any depth. The mashed potatoes were just luke warm (should be one of the hottest things in a steakhouse). Just overall abhorrent service. Won't be back for a $250 (with tip) per person meal with this lack of quality/service

This is dining done at its finest. The ole battle axe and I took our night out and turned it into stomach stuffing class and prestige. Our server maintained a perfect balance of checking in without helicoptering. We snagged the corner booth, visible to the left upon entry facing a dimly lit but stately bar. We were presented our choice of the steaks for the night, so I chose a 3oz wagyu. Our duck wings might be the best in the city. The chicken my girlfriend had was moist and perfectly prepared. The sides were the money and would blatantly tell any critic of this restaurant to delete their yelp account. 

5 stars.
Outstanding - really top notch food and service, easily one of the best steakhouses in NYC. Well worth it.

Highly recommend. This place offers great quality apps, drinks and even song selection, which is always key in keeping up the vibes at a fancy place like this! Visited on a Saturday night which is probably more busy than usual, they were able to accommodate our party of 8 pretty quickly, which wouldn't be the case usually without reservations. AMAZING TOMAHAWK STEAK, hands down . Very professional and friendly staff members. Had a great night over all. Will def. be coming back here .

Incredible service and wonderful dining experience. The ambiance was exactly what we wanted with classic songs and hints of romance playing over the speakers. We were seated at a comfortable booth where we both could people watch and be close. 
As they are known for their meats, we ordered the meats. We got the bone-in ribeye and the dry-aged flatiron steaks. Both were spectacular. If I were to go with one, I would pick the rib-eye which had more flavor and was more tender. The sides of brussel sprouts and whipped potatoes didn't disappoint. Oysters were also delicious as a starter. We finished the occasion dinner with an affogato with a biscotti *chefs kiss* -- not too much but just enough sweetness to complete. 
I have to add that their California red blend Chappellet was some of the best wine I've tasted. 
Overall, 5 stars for ambiance, service and quality of food.

1. The bartender uses his fingers to place ice in glasses.
2. After a reservation, once our "table was ready", we were led to just stand there in the middle of the room for a few minutes, doing nothing. (Why didn't they just leave us at the bar?!)
It took another 30m for anyone to come by for drinks, after asking multiple times.
3. Kind service, but impossible to flag anyone down. Servers are zipping by at all times.
4. Food ok. It's just ok. Menu looks delicious, but really not that delicious. 

I would have given this a 3, but the bartenders fingers thing really disgusted me. Additionally my drink, which was not jalapeno-infused, tasted like jalapeno. Which was probably contamination from EVERYTHING else he was making that night. Ugh.

I had forgotten to mention that they offered to cut our steak to have it be two adjacent donenesses.  It came out as one, further overdone. Ugh. So having forgotten this, I would have kept this at 2; and additionally the bare fingers thing. Ugh.

Ugh.

By chance i choose this steakhouse  on Google maps.. because of location. Lol The restaurant and manager Dylan Hines were very accommodating to my family and my elderly father. We were going to seated in a booth but my father has trouble and requested  to be another regular seat and table.. We ask for a chair that had sides arms so that my father wouldn't fall and the personal took care of the chair issue..I look at the menu the prices is the high but once the steaks came out it was amazing..get the bacon  !!! The sides were a little small but we didn't come here for them ..lol. Usually we go to old homestead, Benji, Gallagher, Stk but here we're definitely come back here!!
Great restaurant. Excellent filet mignon and strip steak. Nice wine selection. Good service in fun atmosphere

If you are a steak and wine guy, this place is heaven. However, be prepared to pay dearly for the experience as well. 

The wagyu steak at medium rare was really really good! It has an extensive wine collection and the 2 bottles we got were fantastic. 

For me, it was my once a lifetime experience as my accountant gave me a lecture on the virtues of managing my expenses properly :-(. 

Definitely recommended!

Came here for an anniversary and the service was amazing! The caviar service was great. The steak however was a little on the dryer side which is a little disappointing. The vibes inside is perfect for date night!

I love my steak and I love my NY steakhouses. I heard a lot of reviews for Bowery Meat Company and figured that it must be similar to other steakhouses in the city. Boy was I wrong...

We ordered the Japanese Wagyu cut on their menu (approximately $400) and instantly regretted it. It did not have the marbling one would expect with Wagyu and it definitely did not taste as good as the bone-in ribeye. 

If you were to ask me what my biggest mistake at a steakhouse was... my answer would involve picking the Japenese Wagyu cut.

I do want to mention that the service was phenomenal and that this review is 3 stars because of the overly expensive and underwhelming Japanese Wagyu cut.

A must place for meat lovers. All kind of nice needs to choose from. The waiter described each beef in details, and would answer any questions you might have. Great wine list. A nice place for group gathering and get together.
Good, not great for the price. $200 for a steak? Cmon. We shared 4 different cuts,  3 tasted the same

The Homemade Riccotta appetizer is to die for, so delicious.  For dinner I had the 16 ounce Ribeye, was too much to finish so I had the most amazing lunch the next day,  Cheers to the chef, our meals was fantastic.
Our meal was wonderful. We started with the broiled oysters. Three women shared one strip steak and 3 sides. This service was 5 star.

Bowery Meat Company (BMC) is a modern steakhouse with a great ambiance. We have been to many steakhouses around the city but none were as impressive as BMC. We enjoyed the presentation of the cuts and the hospitality of the wait staff. 

We ordered the 100 day dry aged NY strip steak with truffle butter and whipped potato. It was rich and flavorful, I'm sure any cut you order will be amazing. The hamachi crudo was delicate and citrusy. I highly recommend the meatballs served with polenta as an appetizer.
Best steakhouse in NYC. Upscale vibe, great cuts of meat, excellent service. This is the place to go for any occasion.

Love this place! Food and drinks were amazing as always. The duck lasagna is to die for. We were particularly impressed with the service; the managers and staff were all incredibly attentive, friendly, and focused on giving us the best experience possible.

Wonderful restaurant! Came here for my Bday last Saturday! WONDERFUL host who accommodated me with my food. Duck wings, Ribeye, peppers, and baked potatoe. It was just too delicious for me to share a picture with you all.

I ordered take out via the Bowery Meat Company website.  It's a limited menu.  All I wanted was a steakhouse caesar' meaning a bit oversized (because steakhouse salads are always large) for $20 and a fully loaded baked potato, pricey for a potato at $20.::.BUT I live in the building and craved those two items so I gritted my teeth and pressed send after being forced to leave a tip of $7 (you cannot not leave a tip on this portal.)  With tax the two items amounted to $50 BUT I'm the jerk who was hungry enough to pay so much for a potato and iceberg lettuce.  So!  I arrive, pay for the food, go up to my apartment and find a tiny salad and MASHED POTATOES, not a fully loaded baked potato.  So!  I walk back down and let the host and manager know my order was incorrect to which I heard the following reply, "oh right, we are out of baked potatoes."  OUT OF BAKED POTATOES?  There is a Whole Food across the street.  You charge $20 for a fully loaded baked potato, how on earth is BMC out of famine food!?  Why did I not get a phone call (they had my contact info) and let me know?  Who made the executive decision to give me mash instead?  SO!  I was offered a menu that was current (only it wasn't because potatoes were still alive and well in black and white print)....but I selected a smaller, less desirable potato option: the fingerling.  I was then told I need to wait 10-15 minutes at the bar (no drink offered-just sit and wait).  NOPE!  I went back upstairs and waited there watching the most recent episode of housewives.  Ten minutes passed and suddenly my internal alarm clock hit me smack dab and down the stairs I go....AGAIN!  I arrive and no host or manager is present.  I spot the manager behind the bar making himself a drink.  Eventually a waiter comes up and asks me what I need.  I say my name and she hands me the food.  I go back upstairs to eat and the fingerlings are yummy but cold; not worth $21.  The salad is still tiny and no better than a Caesar ordered from a Greek diner.  If you have managed to read this far down here is my closing comment:  don't eat here.
Went here on thanksgiving and WOAH. Incredible food and service all around. Nice staff, great ambiance, AMAZING food.

Came here for restaurant week, they had a great deal.

The steak was so absolutely tender. It was some of the best steak I've ever had. 

Service was incredible, atmosphere is sophisticated and classic.

I can't wait for the next round of restaurant week so I can come back.

5/5
Another amazing nyc steakhouse on a corporate dime.  Amazing dinner, service and ambiance.
Very clean and spacious places the steaks was very good good conversation and clean place
Great everything. Secret off menu burger they only have 5 a day!! The steaks are excellent!!

I came for their stakes, and that was a waste of time and money.
first I've ordered  their "supreme" and recommended steak MR, it served in room temperature and not felt like it was grilled but like it was steamed.
I asked to Replace it to their NY strip steak that should be as they were right, a better steak, it really felt like it was grilled, BUT it came as MW and NOT as MR.
Of course that I was tired of changing my dishes and ate the entire thing, but for such a price they should cook better.
The service was great.

Okay friends, ever since my small town girl moved to the big city, she has introduced me to new things and experiences. It's funny because she only ate Campbell's chicken noodle soup for breakfast every day for 18 years!  This was a wonderful experience. I could write pages but I'll hit the highlights. Lord, it was all a high for me. I'm not a wino even though I love it. But I have always been a cheap date!  The broiled oysters were to die for, tomahawk steak, ( WHAT!) just incredible, duck lasagna was a new experience and divine , but the best dish was a food memory for my girl. The mashed potatoes!  Always her favorite, she believes these potatoes have something so special. I should have asked for the recipe. We had other dishes as well, but honestly everything was exemplary. The sommelier was new and could not have been nicer. Especially for a doofus like me! A delightful time for me and my girl!

I'm not a huge meat guy, most know me as "the fish guy", but I would be remiss not to leave a glowing review for the Bowery Meat Company (BMC).

If you've seen my other reviews, you'll know that I'm not only "the fish guy" but I'm also "the vibe guy". BMC is all about vibes - I love the mood and setting. It's really intimate and comfortable. Pretty sure a lot of celebrities come here too, so be on your best behavior. 

I have to make note on this because this was just amazing. There was one guy there who provided the most epic service ever. Everyone was great, but this young man was on a different level. Let me just say, if you're trapped in the Sahara desert, you will not die of thirst if you have this guy with you. Every single minute, the server would come around and refill your water. You take one sip - water is refilled to the top. Your glass never goes below 90% full. He will be there to fill you up! Sometimes you look away for one second and look back at the table and your glass is full - but the guy is nowhere in site. An absolute wizard. Give this man a raise. 

For the food, honestly, what really blew me away was the duck lasagna. Wow. I'm still speechless. I think it's better than any steak I've ever had and even comparable to some of my favorite fish dishes. Yes. That good. Also the duck wings are soooo good - crispy, meaty, not too fatty, and topped with the most perfect sauce. 

5/5!!!
Great food, great vibe and great drinks lasagna and SBaby Gem Caesar Saladnake River Wagu are worth it.

Come here for a phenomenal steakhouse experience! There are so many different, delicious cuts to choose from. I got the 10oz filet mignon au poivre and it was INCREDIBLE. The steak is seasoned so well and the sauce was perfection. I finished the entire thing so fast. My friends got the ribeye and I loved theirs as well!

For dessert, we got the cast iron chocolate chip cookie and WOW this may be my new fave dessert. The cookie is so warm and comes with vanilla ice cream and caramel drizzle. PLEASE GET THIS. I am already missing it, wanting another.

Let me tell you something......being in the Industry one tends to have a certain amount of expectations and boy oh boy was this experience simply out of the park. When I dine solo I always do so at the Bar and from the initial greeting from Cristina the Bartender, the pace was set for a memorable time. It was all Uphill from there. The food was excellent, the broiled oysters to start were to the Max and the steak was top quality and even the kind gesture Cristina offered with the house made Ricotta while i was waiting on my steak was above and beyond and dam was it tasty. The converstaion, casual and attentive interaction in service was engaging and simply excellent. Thanks Cristina, I shall return. I hope that when management sees this they relay to Cristina as I do with our Team members, as acknowledgement is valuable to the frontline members, it will mean the world to them and validates the great effort they put in to doing an amazing job for the Company. Thanks again Bowery Meat.

Classic, solid steakhouse with that old-school (meaning excellent) service but a more modern ambiance. The presentation of meats had me drooling. The bone-in ribeye was perfection (and "for one" is plenty for two average eaters). The ravioli was so soft and creamy. Ended the night with a hot gooey chocolate chip cookie with vanilla ice cream in cast iron. Great Bowery restaurant, high praise.

I was surprised by how good the steaks are. The steaks are different from the butter drenched styles of Peter Lugers and Benjamin's. Its more dry aged and clean and lean tasting. I liked it but it might not be for you if you like the butter drenched versions.

Appetizers and sides were all great. The only reason I'm not giving five stars is the service is painfully slow. The steaks came out about 30 mins after we finished the apps. Basically the steaks came out an hr and a half into dinner.

This was by far my favorite experience in NY. From the service, food, and atmosphere Bowery has it all. Before our reservation started the staff reached out asking if we had any requests. I messaged back asking for a quieter table and was responded within minutes that the accommodation would be made. They were also able to seat us early even though they were booked that night. The service was incredible from the moment we entered and our server was fabulous! Answered all questions and made great recommendations. The Ricotta was brought to us complimentary! The food was delicious flavorful and excellent quality! From the salad, steak, clams and everything else all were a hit at the table. We left full, happy, and very impressed! I highly recommend this place. I look forward to coming back again on my next trip up soon!

Had a really good time here, the food was amazing, the wine selection was massive and the ambiance has a very dark and intimate setting. I ended up getting the New York strip which was cooked to perfection. Service can be a little slow but everything else is great.

Not worth the price tag!  The service was slow, the steaks were all overcooked.  That should be their #1 priority, the meat!  It's in the name!  No one even came to check on how our steaks were.  A manager walked by and didn't bother to wait for a response to his question.  I have had better experiences at an Outback.  Sad!  I will say that the sides were all very good but that's not why we went there.

Our friends were visiting the city and asked for "the best steaks in NYC", so we brought them to BMC. They raved about the quality of the food and service -- and the great atmosphere.  We ordered a few steaks for two -- the dry aged Porterhouse, the double cut Strip -- every cut was perfectly prepared. As locals, we're lucky we can pop in any time for this exceptional experience; our friends are already planning their return visit.  Thanks to the team for taking such great care of us.
Our food was delicious, music/ ambiance were great and Paul took excellent care of us.

I gave this place a 4 or 5 stars a year ago, but it now gets a 1 because the manager was rude and didn't allow me to order their $40 burger to the dinner table. When I complained, she said they would allow it if 8 people ordered an entree, when there was a table of 7 of us. I've ordered it many times in the past without problems. I got some truffle pasta dish, which was absolutely disgusting. I will never dine here again. I honestly give this place 1 more year - there's no way they will keep up with the rent given the low business they get, especially with that attitude.
Excellent food and service. Our chateaubriand was perfectly prepared with high quality product. Sommelier was knowledgeable and informative.

Most steakhouses either shine with their appetizers or with their meat. I have to say this one shines with the former. Our group of 6 ordered the hamachi, Caesar salad, Mac & cheese, kung pao duck wings, and bacon and I was blown away by all but the last one. I've had better bacon elsewhere but for all the other apps, each one was so flavorful! They also come by with a big 20 pound slab of meat to help you choose your meat and we were going to go with a porterhouse and 2 ny strips but got steered to 2 porterhouses instead (more money, but also more meat). Spoiler, we left a little meat anyway so maybe we could have skipped it? The filet sides did go first in our group so I'll say it was probably worth following our waiter's recommendation. We also got a side of Brussels sprouts and fingerling potatoes. Both were, again, amazing. The steak was good but probably could have used a little less cooking with less of a char ring around it since it gives the outside an overcooked taste. The inside is very nice (good business or date spot) and the service is very on point. We got drinks, all that food and left full and happy for about $140 pp after tip... not bad at all!

Dined here last night for a Birthday dinner. Ordered the Hamachi Crudo to start, 8oz Wagyu (special for the night), Duck Lasagna, and ended our meal with a scoop of the Cookies & Cream and Strawberry Gelato. I already knew we would have leftovers from the Lasagna but really wanted to try it so we still ordered it. All our dishes were delicious and the quality matched the price point. We also ordered the bottle of Chateauneuf du Pape which was divine. The only negative of the night was that our waiter barely checked up on us. He was friendly enough but felt a bit neglected. On a mission to try all of the steakhouses in NY for special occasions, and Bowery Meat Company is definitely a top 5 so far!
Our waiter is the same everytime and he's unbelievable, always knows what to recommend and such. All staff was helpful and friendly, we had a great time! Can't wait to come back soon.

We went there after reading the reviews, and it did not disappoint. Our appetizers were duck wings and broiled oysters. Both amazing! The chateaubriand was cooked to perfection (medium rare ) and the drinks were fantastic. Service was fast, even though the place got busy. Music was a bit loud, but the selection was good. Pricey?? Yes. Wine bottles start around $100 and go up from there. But for a special occasion, it's worth it!!
Came back with friends from out of town. Successfully put them in a state of comatose. Friends also mentioned that the playlist was hopping.
The steak was at the standard level for this type of dining. Nice vibes for weekend dinner, tho the seats could be too close to each other.

Great steaks but we didn't have the best experience during our May visit. Our server was not the most forthcoming - we ordered a tomahawk which came with vegetables and a small side, and then he asked us if we wanted additional sides (without letting us know this already came with the tomahawk). Of course we overordered.
This would have been forgiveable if the tomahawk was otherworldly- but it was gristley to boot!
Overall the meal was $500 and while it wasn't terrible, I really did think we felt a little ripped off.

This restaurant was so good!!! The ambiance was super sexy. Very dimly lite and amazing decor. Our waiter was terrific and basically predicted everything I was about to ask him. We order dirty martinis with blue cheese stuffed olives (a must) and champagne with our caviar as the appetizer. All amazing. 

For the main course we ordered the Lobster Mac and cheese which was the special and then a porterhouse. Again all AMAZING. 

For dessert, we order the bread pudding which is very big for two people but we took the rest home and so should you because it was so freakin good. 

Amazing all around. I will definitely be back

Don't order online , they never pick up the phone and they will take your order and never respond or even put it in motion. They will waste your time and money. I'm sure the restaurant food is great but the service and the courtesy to any online ordering is subpar amateur.

We had to find a reservation last minute and called American Express concierge - they found and recommended Bowery.

The drinks are unique and tasty. My wife can't have alcohol so she really liked the mint mango refresher. I had the 'sharper than a knife' which was excellent.

The broiled breaded oysters were unique and tasty - we split them.

My wife had the loaded baked potato and loved it.

But she also had a little of my NY strip and rarely likes steak - and really liked it.

I have eaten at steak houses all over the world... have to hand it to Bowery. Their NY strip was exceptional. Perfectly prepared - slight pepper but not over the top. Almost a buttery taste. Great flavor all the way through.

Their Brussel sprouts were good, with a tangy sauce. 

Great vibe, we wanted a good date night and this was 5 star. Friendly staff, great food and prompt service. Nice intimate tables as well.

Worth making the trip. We will be back.

100% best steakhouse in Manhattan!! Don't underestimate the power of sharing a meal here, while the prices seem high, the portions more than make up for it. 

The #1 dish you absolutely MUST order when you go here is the Duck Lasagna - you can't find something like this anywhere else and trust me, it will blow your mind (plus it's portioned out for 6 people so you definitely get the bang for your buck). 

I'd also definitely recommend the ricotta pomegranate toast and add the shishito peppers on any cut of meat you choose! 

Ambiance and service is also top notch, and the servers are very attentive to celebrating important events with you!

Delicious but not worth the money any more. I've eaten here 3 times and each time it's gotten a little less worth the money, which is considerable.  Service was just not up to snuff, except for the sommelier who was wonderful. The staff are pleasant but the servers need to be better trained, reaching across our table to hand out drinks, etc. When we arrived and were seated in the smaller side room, the room temperature was way too hot and humid. I asked our initial server if something could be done about the air conditioning and he proceeded to man-splain to me that it was hot because of the small size of the room and all the people in it.  No kidding. The server explaining the meat tray put the meat right in our face and flopped it around and smacked it which was just made it all seem like it was trash instead of something we were about to spend a fortune on. I've been through their routine before but was not impressed with the presentation this time.  That said, the meal was absolutely delicious and our steaks perfectly cooked. The sides we had (asparagus, fries, fingerlings, garlic confit, béarnaise sauce etc.) were spectacular. 

If you are looking for a fancy place for a really expensive bro-party, you'll be in good company but it's tightly packed. The ambiance is elegant but better when it's not crowded. The meal was exceptional but I don't think we'll be back.
Enjoyed our meal.  Great service and steaks were perfect.  We had a party of 8 and food came really quick. Staffs were friendly.  Would totally recommend this restaurant.
The meat selection is great!! My daughter Sydney loved the French fries and the filet! And our waiter Jonah was fantastic!!!

Very impressed and a huge thank you to Paul, our awesome server! Food and ambience were very good.  Pricey? Yes. But we really felt so taken care of. We tried the whipped ricotta, broiled oysters (yum!), famous duck lasagna (MUST try!), dry-aged double-cut strip 34OZ (for 2) with charred red onion. We also tried creamed spinach and Hash brown sides. Spinach was excellent as was the steak!! We then tried the cookie skillet- excellent! We had an awesome time- never felt rushed out and really enjoyed the food!!! Would recommend for a special occasion!

DO NOT EAT HERE. I have lived in NYC for 7 years, eaten at restaurants all over the city and this was by far, my WORST experience from the service to the food, to the fact that I got very severe food poisoning, and worst of all was the lack of follow through from the GM. 
I came here on a Saturday night with a friend and ordered the broiled oysters and gem salad to share, she got the strip and I ordered the fillet and we split the carrot cake for desert. We each only got one drink. The salad was the only good thing we ate here, the oysters were bland other than the vague taste of stale water, my steak was over cooked to the point of being tough and the carrot cake - I've had better dessert from a bodega. 
Our waiter was seen maybe 3 times, did not check on how the food was. We had to flag him down for both dessert and the check. We paid around $400 for this disgusting meal. 
My friend started to feel off on Sunday, but given that she is more prone to this than I am, I didn't think too much of it. That was until Monday, whilst I was in the middle of a bride's pre-wedding color appointment and throwing up in my salon. I couldn't eat for a week following this. I ran a fever for FIVE days. I couldn't work (I work for myself so if I'm not working I am not getting paid). I contacted the restaurant after recieving an email requesting feedback. No one contacted me until I followed up. Sean, the GM, eventually reached out to me saying that they would be refunding our meal. No such thing has happened and it's been over a month, and no one has followed up beyond that even after I reached back out. 
To say this place left a bad taste in my mouth would be a gross understatement.

It's a great place to celebrate my bday dinner. The ambiance is nice and chill. However, my bf and I are both kinda disappointed about the steak. We got dry day prime filet 10 oz and Rib-Eye 12 oz both are rare or medium rare. My dry-day medium rare filet tastes very salty. The service is alright and could be better. When we just got in, one of the waitress who seated us, she accidentally poured the water on the table and didn't take care of it. So my bf wiped it out eventually lol. We eat out and pay for the service with tips, we expect to have great experience. I hope whoever saw my review would pay attention on this. The highlight of the dinner is actually the baked potato, Cesar salad and bacon! We recommend them~

food....steak.....not upscale; Brussels undercooked;
when my glass is empty, offer me a drink please
service.....average at best
ambiance......nice
overall.....not worth the price
can easily find better
the truth hurts, I know.

Made reservations for a Friday birthday celebration. Me and my boyfriend were given a booth which we really loved. To start, we ordered the mac & cheese and the hash brown. The mac & cheese was so creamy and the hash brown was so flavorful. For our entree, we each ordered the 22 ounce, bone in, rib steak cooked medium rare. We also got their house sauce and the truffle butter. Highly Recommend both but if I had to choose one, would get the house. It was exactly as it was described: an elevated A1 sauce. My boyfriend also got an aviation to drink while I got the "I was adorable once". Also loved my drink. We were too full for dessert but little chocolates were brought out with "happy birthday" written on the dish. It was such a pleasant surprise. Overall would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a quality food and good service.

Delicious food and great service, compliments to the chef!

The ambiance is casual and elegant . The team is very supportive. The chef helped us to choose the right food and it was all very well prepared. We ate the porterhouse steak for two, perfectly cooked and cut and the right amount for two, paired with mushrooms and sauteed spinach which went very well together.  Overall a great dining experience and I look forward to dining there again soon. *****
Darlene was incredible! Extremely knowledgeable and awesome service. The ambiance is cozy and romantic, and the food was great!

Came here on a whim for date night and WOW were we blown away. They have an extensive cocktail menu but we stuck with wine; a solid selection available. Started with the bacon macaroni and cheese which was to die for with smoky chunks of thick slab bacon in a thick Gouda cheese sauce; that alone was a meal in itself. For our main event we decided on the aged porterhouse for two, truffle garlic fingerling potatoes, and the sautéed spinach. The meat was cooked beautifully and oh so tender, and the house sauce was the perfect accompaniment. The potatoes had excellent flavor and were cooked perfectly to where they had creamy insides and crispy outsides. The spinach was also cooked perfectly in sautéed garlic and made for some solid side vegetation. A very large hunk of carrot cake rounded off the meal - the brown sugar bourbon icing on it was decadent. The service throughout the meal exceeded expectations, the vibe on the inside was perfect for a date night (low lighting and comfortable seating) and the playlist of newer R&B/smooth jams was very enjoyable. All made for a more comfortable and modern steakhouse experience that anyone could enjoy. The sheet amount of food was WILD we walked out with a large bag of leftovers from each course, probably could have had a third person join us and still would have walked out with leftovers. Fast before you come here, it will be so worth it.

This was our second visit to Bowery Meat Company.  We arrived on a weeknight without a reservation and were quickly seated.  Great ambiance.  Our server was knowledgeable and helpful.  We ordered the grilled octopus, filet, sautéed spinach and  fries.  The truffle butter was a great addition!  Would love to have had the duck lasagna again as it is excellent, maybe next time.

My wife and I made a reservation for a Friday evening. When we arrived at the time of our reservation we were quoted 30 minutes or more before we could sit because the restaurant was running behind. The bar was full, so it was suggested to us we come back then. 

We had made a reservation only a couple hours earlier and there was availability at nearly every time. The restaurant knew they would not be able to seat us at the reserved time. 

We walked over to Vic's a couple blocks away and had a wonderful dinner.

Food 4.0/5.0
Service 4.0/5.0
Value 3.0/5.0
Decor 4.0/5.0
Overall 4.0/5.0

Steaks were decent. The duck lasagna was very good. Definitely get the duck lasagna.
Such an exceptional meal. From the ambiance to the service, this restaurant was top-notch.

30 day aged porterhouse steak for two had too much of the fat for a professional steak house. The meat was cooked right but it was way too overpriced. Plus the house bbq sauce had too much of tomato paste flavor. That it was overpowering the "smoky" flavor that they said thats going to be there. Overall it was just way too overpriced. The marbling of the meat, the amount of fat ( that should've been chopped off), and etc. was a disappointment. Two drinks and steak for two came out to 145 plus tax

Food is incredible, possibly the best steakhouse in the city. Place is classy and doesn't have a corporate feel like some other steakhouses. Drinks are good and come pretty quick. I loved the meat cart they come around before you order to show you the different cuts. 

The only negative is it very expensive, even relative to other steakhouses in the city.

Recently had the Porterhouse Steak and here's my take:

Porterhouse Steak: 4 star
The Porterhouse was a notable experience. Cooked just shy of my requested medium-rare, it still showcased a good sear and a decent flavor profile. The steak was juicy and tender, though it lacked that "wow" factor in terms of seasoning and overall wow factor. What it did right was its natural beefy flavor, which was definitely commendable.

Definitely get the Tomahawk steak, Pieter house steak was a little disappointing. For the sides, get the fingerlings, really good. Decor was a 4. Way too loud and can't have a decent conversation with your party.

Nice experience, great ambience, customer service was great.. I ordered 2 orders of the grilled oysters and my friend had the caviar. The food was good, fresh and didn't take long to come out. This was my first time eating here and I will definitely be back..
Fabulous personalized service.  Great food.  Lovely ambiance. The appetizers and drinks were perfect. Overall a wonderful experience

We ordered a lot of steak (different kinds)..
They all came out great and delicious. I was also impressed with their sides.. finally desert was amazing.. only issue is it's a bit pricey..

Our server Ben was amazing.  Took care of our every need without any hesitation.  The manager was also wonderful and gave us free glasses of champagne for my wife's birthday.  Food was outstanding and the staff were all superstars.  This is why I will continue to dine at bowery meat company.

Bowery Meat Company is a great spot for steaks and seafood. 
The steaks are cooked perfectly, as ordered. 
The salads, soups and appetizers are delicious. 
The seafood choices are great and delicious. 
We loved all the sides. 
The service was on point. The server was professional and made sure we were happy with our food. 
The management team was impressive.  Walking the room and stopping at the tables. 
We will definitely come back.

The food was very delicious however i would say 4/5

the service & ambiance was very amazing. 5/5
